\hypertarget{front-matter}{%
\chapter{Front matter}\label{front-matter}}

This document is a combined view of the 13 core implementation
milestones plus an 8-file gap-fill series covering the load-bearing
seams the v1 milestones left implicit. The M-series (M0-M12) is the v1
build plan; the G-series (G1-G8) is the gap-fill written after a
self-review.

Each chapter below is self-contained and corresponds to one milestone
file in \texttt{milestones/}. The high-level plan and the cross-cutting
concerns live in \texttt{principia\_milestones.md}; the canonical
implementation specification is \texttt{principia\_spec\_revised.tex}.

\newpage

\newpage

\hypertarget{m0-foundations-project-skeleton-math-primitives-ci-gate}{%
\chapter{M0 --- Foundations: project skeleton, math primitives, CI
gate}\label{m0-foundations-project-skeleton-math-primitives-ci-gate}}

\hypertarget{goal}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal}}

A fresh clone runs \texttt{npm\ install\ \&\&\ npm\ test} and lands
green, with the math/decoder/integrator tests that later milestones lean
on already in place.

\textbf{Exit criterion (single executable test).}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/unit/math}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

passes with at least 30 unit tests, all of which are green.

\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Tuple types for plane and 8D latent vectors. Tuples (rather than}
\CommentTok{ * \textasciigrave{}number[]\textasciigrave{}) give us length{-}checked arithmetic at compile time.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ Vec2 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number]}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ Vec3 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number]}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ Vec4 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number]}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ Vec8 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [}
\NormalTok{  number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ number}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}

\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{T}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [T}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ T}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ T]}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Trajectory state in the COM frame.}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Positions and momenta are kept per{-}body. Masses sum to 1 in the}
\CommentTok{ * dimensionless system (M = 1, G = 1, I = 1).}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export interface TrajState \{}
  \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{Vec2}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{};}   \CommentTok{// positions}
  \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{Vec2}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{};}   \CommentTok{// momenta}
  \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ m}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3}\OperatorTok{;}           \CommentTok{// masses, sum = 1}
  \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ t}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}         \CommentTok{// simulation time}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Terminal labels, used at decode time and by the integrator\textquotesingle{}s event}
\CommentTok{ * detection. These are total — every UV pixel ends up in exactly one}
\CommentTok{ * state (spec §1.6.7, §4).}
\CommentTok{ */}
\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ TerminalLabel }\OperatorTok{=}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}NONE\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}DEGENERATE\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{string}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}COLLISION\_T0\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pair}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0} \OperatorTok{|} \DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{|} \DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}COLLISION\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pair}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0} \OperatorTok{|} \DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{|} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ t}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ESCAPE\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ body}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0} \OperatorTok{|} \DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{|} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ t}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}BOUNDED\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ T}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}TIMEOUT\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ T}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}MAX\_SUBSTEPS\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ t}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}}
  \OperatorTok{|}\NormalTok{ \{ kind}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}SIM\_FAILED\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ t}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}
\end{Highlighting}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Numerically stable sigmoid that avoids \textasciigrave{}exp\textasciigrave{} overflow for large negative z.}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * For z \textgreater{}= 0:  σ(z) = 1 / (1 + exp({-}z))}
\CommentTok{ * For z \textless{}  0:  σ(z) = exp(z) / (1 + exp(z))}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{sigmoid}\NormalTok{(z}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (z }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{) \{}
\NormalTok{    const e }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{exp}\NormalTok{(}\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{z)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    return }\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ e)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \} else \{}
\NormalTok{    const e }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{exp}\NormalTok{(z)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    return e }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ e)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \}}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Inverse of sigmoid on (0, 1). Caller is responsible for clamping the}
\CommentTok{ * input away from the endpoints (use \{}\AnnotationTok{@link}\CommentTok{ }\CommentVarTok{clamp01\}}\CommentTok{).}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{logit}\NormalTok{(s}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  return }\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{log}\NormalTok{(s }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ s))}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * artanh for inputs in ({-}1, 1). Caller clamps.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{artanh}\NormalTok{(x}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{rotation}\NormalTok{(theta}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Mat2 \{}

\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{applyR}\NormalTok{(R}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Mat2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ v}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 \{}

\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}

\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{reflectX}\NormalTok{(v}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 \{ return [v[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]]}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ \}}

\hypertarget{m1-cpu-reference-integrator-single-trajectory-f64}{%
\chapter{M1 --- CPU reference integrator (single trajectory,
f64)}\label{m1-cpu-reference-integrator-single-trajectory-f64}}

\hypertarget{goal-1}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-1}}

A self-contained, pure-TypeScript integrator that produces the ground
truth every later GPU result is checked against. Includes KDK leapfrog
with adaptive substepping, optional Yoshida-4 / Yoshida-6 compositions,
COM projection, energy and L\_z monitoring, collision and three-gate
escape detection.

\textbf{Exit criterion (single executable test).}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/golden/burrau}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

The Burrau 3-4-5 rest start integrates to \texttt{T\ =\ 80} with
relative energy drift below \texttt{1e-7}, and the body identity that
escapes matches the reference.

\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ TrajState}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{burrau-golden-test}{%
\subsection{Burrau golden test}\label{burrau-golden-test}}

The 3-4-5 Burrau rest start is well-studied. The published reference
outcome is that body 1 (the lightest, opposite the longest leg) escapes
after a sequence of close encounters around \texttt{t\ ≈\ 60}, leaving
bodies 0 and 2 in a binary. We pin a shorter-horizon golden file with
the position of each body at fixed checkpoint times so failures localise
quickly.

Generate the reference file once with a high-precision integrator
(Yoshida 6 at \texttt{dt\ =\ 1e-4}), then commit it.

Notes on the reference file: the checkpoint positions are illustrative
shapes (the actual numbers should be regenerated against your own
high-precision run when you first land M1). The point of committing the
file is that any future change to the integrator that shifts these
positions beyond \texttt{tolerance\_position} is caught immediately.

\hypertarget{acceptance-check-1}{%
\section{Acceptance check}\label{acceptance-check-1}}

\texttt{test/golden/burrau.test.ts} passes: energy drift is below
\texttt{1e-7}, the terminal label is \texttt{ESCAPE} for body 1, and all
four checkpoint positions agree with the reference to within 0.02 in
dimensionless units.

\hypertarget{notes-for-the-implementer}{%
\section{Notes for the implementer}\label{notes-for-the-implementer}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Generating the reference file.} The committed positions in
  \texttt{burrau\_345\_reference.json} are placeholder targets. On first
  implementation, run Yoshida 6 at \texttt{dt\ =\ 1e-4} and capture the
  actual positions, then commit that as the reference. Subsequent
  changes that drift outside the tolerance become diff-visible.
\item
  \textbf{Subseptcount parameter.} \texttt{NMax\ =\ 256} for the golden
  test rather than the spec default of 64. The Burrau encounters are
  tighter than typical and the goal here is to nail the reference, not
  to test the saturation cap. Production rendering uses 64.
\item
  \textbf{Integrator family choice for the gate.} Use Yoshida 6 in the
  golden test even though the GPU pipeline runs KDK in Preview tier. The
  test is checking the reference, not the production speed/accuracy
  trade-off.
\end{itemize}

\newpage

\hypertarget{m2-decoder-atlas-canonicaliser-inverse-paths}{%
\chapter{M2 --- Decoder atlas, canonicaliser, inverse
paths}\label{m2-decoder-atlas-canonicaliser-inverse-paths}}

\hypertarget{goal-2}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-2}}

The single decoder pipeline that every chart funnels through. Mass
decode (softmax with logit saturation, plus direct-simplex alternative),
configuration decode (canonical-frame hyperspherical Jacobi), free
Jacobi momentum decode, canonicaliser with rotation/mirror/scale gauges,
no-holes guard, and inverse encode paths.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/unit/decode test/golden/decode}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

The lookup round-trip (mass / configuration / free-momentum) holds to
better than \texttt{1e-9} at 1000 random non-saturated points; landmark
configurations (α=0, α=π/2, equilateral with equal masses) decode to the
expected geometric shapes; and the no-holes contract holds: every UV
pixel lands in either a valid IC or a labelled terminal.

\begin{Shaded}

\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec8}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ TerminalLabel}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ TrajState \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{ * The latent 8D point. Components, in order:}
\CommentTok{ *   0,1: configuration (z\_α, z\_β)}

\NormalTok{export interface DecodeKnobs \{}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Triple \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ JacobiMomenta \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Reconstruct particle positions from unweighted Jacobi vectors:}
\CommentTok{ *   r\_\{01\} = {-}m\_2 λ}
\CommentTok{ *   r\_2    =  M\_\{01\} λ}
\CommentTok{ *   r\_0    = r\_\{01\} {-} (m\_1/M\_\{01\}) ρ}
\CommentTok{ *   r\_1    = r\_\{01\} + (m\_0/M\_\{01\}) ρ}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{jacobiToParticlePositions}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  rho}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lambda}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ m}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{Vec2}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  const M01 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{  const r2}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [M01 }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ lambda[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ M01 }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ lambda[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const r0}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [r01x }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01) }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ rho[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ r01y }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01) }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ rho[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const r1}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [r01x }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01) }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ rho[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ r01y }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01) }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ rho[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return [r0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ r1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ r2]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Inverse of the position reconstruction.}
\CommentTok{ *   ρ = r\_1 {-} r\_0}
\CommentTok{ *   λ = r\_2 {-} (m\_0 r\_0 + m\_1 r\_1) / M\_\{01\}}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{particlePositionsToJacobi}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  r}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Triple}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{Vec2}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{},}\NormalTok{ m}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ \{ rho}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ lambda}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 \} \{}
\NormalTok{  const M01 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const cx }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{r[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{][}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{r[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{][}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const cy }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{r[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{][}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{r[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{][}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{testgoldendecode_landmarks.test.ts}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{test/golden/decode\_landmarks.test.ts}}{test/golden/decode\_landmarks.test.ts}}\label{testgoldendecode_landmarks.test.ts}}

The shape-sphere coordinate convention (corrected per spec revisions)
places the inner-pair collision at \texttt{n\ =\ (1,\ 0,\ 0)} and the
equilateral configuration at the poles. This test verifies that landmark
configurations decode to the expected shapes.

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ describe}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ it}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ expect \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}vitest\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ decodeConfigCanonical \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/decode/configuration.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ jacobiToParticlePositions \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/decode/jacobi\_particle.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ ALPHA\_MIN\_DEFAULT \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/constants.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\FunctionTok{describe}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}decode landmarks\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
  \FunctionTok{it}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}α near 0 gives a near{-}degenerate configuration with body 2 at the inner{-}pair COM\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{    const c }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{decodeConfigCanonical}\NormalTok{(}\OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{1e6}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ ALPHA\_MIN\_DEFAULT)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \CommentTok{// |λ̃| / |ρ̃| should be small → body 2 essentially co{-}located with the}
    \CommentTok{// inner pair\textquotesingle{}s COM.}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{hypot}\NormalTok{(}\OperatorTok{...}\NormalTok{c}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{lambdaTilde}\NormalTok{))}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeLessThan}\NormalTok{(}\FloatTok{0.1}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{hypot}\NormalTok{(}\OperatorTok{...}\NormalTok{c}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{rhoTilde}\NormalTok{   ))}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeGreaterThan}\NormalTok{(}\FloatTok{0.99}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \})}\OperatorTok{;}

  \FunctionTok{it}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}α near π/2 gives a tight inner pair (Burrau{-}like hierarchy)\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{    const c }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{decodeConfigCanonical}\NormalTok{(}\FloatTok{1e6}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ ALPHA\_MIN\_DEFAULT)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{hypot}\NormalTok{(}\OperatorTok{...}\NormalTok{c}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{rhoTilde}\NormalTok{   ))}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeLessThan}\NormalTok{(}\FloatTok{0.1}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(}\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{hypot}\NormalTok{(}\OperatorTok{...}\NormalTok{c}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{lambdaTilde}\NormalTok{))}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeGreaterThan}\NormalTok{(}\FloatTok{0.99}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \})}\OperatorTok{;}

  \FunctionTok{it}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}equal{-}mass equilateral triangle has |ρ̃|² = |λ̃|² and ρ̃ ⊥ λ̃\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
    \CommentTok{// Place the equal{-}mass equilateral configuration directly.}
\NormalTok{    const m }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{] }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ const}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const r }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{jacobiToParticlePositions}\NormalTok{([}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ [}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ m)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \CommentTok{// |ρ| = 1, |λ| = √3/2.  μ\_ρ = (1/9)/(2/3) = 1/6.  μ\_λ = (1/3)(2/3) = 2/9.}
    \CommentTok{// |ρ̃|² = (1/6)*1 = 1/6.  |λ̃|² = (2/9)*(3/4) = 1/6.  ✓}
\NormalTok{    const muRho    }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const muLambda }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{(m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const rhoT    }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\DecValTok{1}                  \OperatorTok{*} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(muRho   )}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const lambdaT }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{2}  \OperatorTok{*} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(muLambda)]}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(rhoT[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{rhoT[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ rhoT[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{rhoT[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])}
      \OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeCloseTo}\NormalTok{(lambdaT[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{lambdaT[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ lambdaT[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{lambdaT[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{12}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(rhoT[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{lambdaT[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ rhoT[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{lambdaT[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeCloseTo}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{12}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\})}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{run-it-2}{%
\section{Run it}\label{run-it-2}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/unit/decode}
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/golden/decode\_landmarks}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\hypertarget{acceptance-check-2}{%
\section{Acceptance check}\label{acceptance-check-2}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/unit/decode test/golden/decode\_landmarks}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

If that exit-codes 0 with all tests green, M2 is done. The pipeline now
has: totality (every UV pixel labelled), round-trip identity (lookup +
lock will work in M8), and landmark agreement (the corrected
shape-sphere formula's geometric basis is consistent with the decoder).

\newpage

\hypertarget{m3-layer-0-flat-grid-gpu-dispatch}{%
\chapter{M3 --- Layer 0: flat grid GPU
dispatch}\label{m3-layer-0-flat-grid-gpu-dispatch}}

\hypertarget{goal-3}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-3}}

First end-to-end pass through WebGPU. No tile cache, no quadtree, no
adaptive refinement. A single tile fills the viewport and the fragment
shader reads \texttt{SimResult} directly from a storage buffer. The
point of the milestone is to land the data contracts
(\texttt{SimResult}, \texttt{ICDescriptor}, \texttt{SimUniforms},
\texttt{TileRequest}) and validate that a GPU integration matches the M1
CPU reference.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/layer0}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

A 16×16 sample of the (3,4,5)-Burrau view classifies every pixel
identically between GPU \texttt{f32} and CPU \texttt{f64}, with
shape-sphere positions agreeing to within \texttt{1e-3} after
\texttt{T\ =\ 50}.

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * GPU struct layouts. Sizes computed under WGSL alignment rules:}
\CommentTok{ *   {-} vec4}\KeywordTok{\textless{}f32\textgreater{}}\CommentTok{ aligns to 16 bytes}
\CommentTok{ *   {-} f32 / u32 align to 4 bytes}
\CommentTok{ *   {-} structs round up to the largest member\textquotesingle{}s alignment}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * These values appear in the spec at §6.6 and are pinned by the}
\CommentTok{ * integration test in \textasciigrave{}layer0\_struct\_alignment.test.ts\textasciigrave{}.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export const M\_DEFAULT }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{sizeOfSimResult}\NormalTok{(M}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ M\_DEFAULT)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
  \CommentTok{// M float4 checkpoints (each 16B)}
  \CommentTok{// 1 uint4 free{-}group word (16B)}
  \CommentTok{// 11 floats: arc\_length, t\_end, d\_min, ftle, energy\_drift, diffusion,}
  \CommentTok{//   delta\_E\_max\_abs, Lz\_drift, delta\_Lz\_max\_abs, E\_0, Lz\_0  (44B)}
  \CommentTok{// 2 uint32: sample\_descriptor, trajectory\_stats  (8B)}
  \CommentTok{// Padded to 16B alignment.}
\NormalTok{  const raw }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{M }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{16} \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{44} \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return }\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{ceil}\NormalTok{(raw }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{16}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{sizeOfICDescriptor}\NormalTok{()}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
  \CommentTok{// 12 floats × 4 bytes = 48, padded to 64.}
\NormalTok{  return }\DecValTok{64}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{sizeOfTileReduction}\NormalTok{(M}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ M\_DEFAULT)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
  \CommentTok{// See spec §6.6 for the field{-}by{-}field count: 268 → 272.}
\NormalTok{  const raw }\OperatorTok{=}
      \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// TileID id (3*i32) + level}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{M                }\CommentTok{// mean\_n\_checkpoints[M]}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{6}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 6 means}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 7 spreads}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 4 classification fields}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 2 invariant drift}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 4 free{-}group fields}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 2 ensemble}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 2 trajectory\_stats reductions}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}                 \CommentTok{// 2 composite scores}
    \OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{*}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{;}                \CommentTok{// 2 metadata}
\NormalTok{  return }\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{ceil}\NormalTok{(raw }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{16}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}

\hypertarget{wgsl-shaders}{%
\section{WGSL shaders}\label{wgsl-shaders}}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadershelpers.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/helpers.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/helpers.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadershelpers.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
// Numeric constants and shared helpers.
const PI: f32 = 3.141592653589793;
const EPS_BOLT: f32 = 1e-30;

fn sigmoid(z: f32) -> f32 {
  if (z >= 0.0) {
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-z));
  } else {
    let e = exp(z);
    return e / (1.0 + e);
  }
}

fn clamp01(x: f32) -> f32 { return clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0); }

fn rotJ(v: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> { return vec2<f32>(-v.y, v.x); }

fn cross_z(a: vec2<f32>, b: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
  return a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
}

// Mass softmax: σ(0, μ_max·tanh(z1), μ_max·tanh(z2)).
fn mass_softmax(z1: f32, z2: f32, mu_max: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  let mu1 = mu_max * tanh(z1);
  let mu2 = mu_max * tanh(z2);
  let m   = max(0.0, max(mu1, mu2));
  let e0 = exp(   - m);
  let e1 = exp(mu1 - m);
  let e2 = exp(mu2 - m);
  let Z  = e0 + e1 + e2;
  return vec3<f32>(e0 / Z, e1 / Z, e2 / Z);
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersdecode.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/decode.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/decode.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersdecode.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
struct ConfigDecoded {
  rho:    vec2<f32>,
  lambda: vec2<f32>,
  m:      vec3<f32>,
  alpha:  f32,
  beta:   f32,
};

fn decode_latent(z: array<f32, 8>, knobs: SimUniforms) -> ConfigDecoded {
  let m  = mass_softmax(z[6], z[7], knobs.mu_max);
  let M01 = m.x + m.y;

  let alpha = knobs.alpha_min
            + (PI/2.0 - 2.0*knobs.alpha_min) * sigmoid(z[0]);
  let beta  = PI * sigmoid(z[1]);

  let rho_t    = vec2<f32>(cos(alpha), 0.0);
  let lambda_t = vec2<f32>(sin(alpha) * cos(beta),
                           sin(alpha) * sin(beta));

  let muRho    = (m.x * m.y) / max(M01, EPS_BOLT);
  let muLambda = m.z * M01;
  let rho    = rho_t    / sqrt(max(muRho,    EPS_BOLT));
  let lambda = lambda_t / sqrt(max(muLambda, EPS_BOLT));

  var out: ConfigDecoded;
  out.rho = rho; out.lambda = lambda; out.m = m;
  out.alpha = alpha; out.beta = beta;
  return out;
}

struct ICOut {
  r: array<vec2<f32>, 3>,
  p: array<vec2<f32>, 3>,
  m: vec3<f32>,
  terminal: u32,                  // 0 = none, 1 = degenerate, 2 = collision_t0
};

fn jacobi_to_particle(
  rho: vec2<f32>, lambda: vec2<f32>, m: vec3<f32>,
) -> array<vec2<f32>, 3> {
  let M01 = m.x + m.y;
  let r01 = -m.z * lambda;
  let r2  =  M01 * lambda;
  let r0  = r01 - (m.y / M01) * rho;
  let r1  = r01 + (m.x / M01) * rho;
  return array<vec2<f32>, 3>(r0, r1, r2);
}

fn jacobi_momenta_to_particle(
  pRho: vec2<f32>, pLambda: vec2<f32>, m: vec3<f32>,
) -> array<vec2<f32>, 3> {
  let M01 = m.x + m.y;
  let p0  = -pRho - (m.x / M01) * pLambda;
  let p1  =  pRho - (m.y / M01) * pLambda;
  let p2  = pLambda;
  return array<vec2<f32>, 3>(p0, p1, p2);
}

fn decode_full(z: array<f32, 8>, knobs: SimUniforms) -> ICOut {
  var out: ICOut;
  let cfg = decode_latent(z, knobs);
  out.m = cfg.m;
  out.r = jacobi_to_particle(cfg.rho, cfg.lambda, cfg.m);

  // Free Jacobi momenta.
  let qx = knobs.q_max * (2.0 * sigmoid(z[2]) - 1.0);
  let qy = knobs.q_max * (2.0 * sigmoid(z[3]) - 1.0);
  let qX = knobs.q_max * (2.0 * sigmoid(z[4]) - 1.0);
  let qY = knobs.q_max * (2.0 * sigmoid(z[5]) - 1.0);
  out.p = jacobi_momenta_to_particle(
    vec2<f32>(qx, qy), vec2<f32>(qX, qY), cfg.m);

  // No-holes guard.
  let d01 = length(out.r[1] - out.r[0]);
  let d02 = length(out.r[2] - out.r[0]);
  let d12 = length(out.r[2] - out.r[1]);
  let dmin = min(d01, min(d02, d12));
  if (dmin < knobs.r_coll) { out.terminal = 2u; }
  else                     { out.terminal = 0u; }
  return out;
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersintegrate.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/integrate.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/integrate.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersintegrate.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
struct State {
  r: array<vec2<f32>, 3>,
  p: array<vec2<f32>, 3>,
  m: vec3<f32>,
  t: f32,
};

fn pairwise_force(m: vec3<f32>, r: array<vec2<f32>, 3>) -> array<vec2<f32>, 3> {
  var F: array<vec2<f32>, 3>;
  F[0] = vec2<f32>(0.0, 0.0);
  F[1] = vec2<f32>(0.0, 0.0);
  F[2] = vec2<f32>(0.0, 0.0);

  let d01 = r[1] - r[0]; let r01 = length(d01); let f01 = m.x*m.y / (r01*r01*r01);
  F[0] += f01 * d01; F[1] -= f01 * d01;

  let d02 = r[2] - r[0]; let r02 = length(d02); let f02 = m.x*m.z / (r02*r02*r02);
  F[0] += f02 * d02; F[2] -= f02 * d02;

  let d12 = r[2] - r[1]; let r12 = length(d12); let f12 = m.y*m.z / (r12*r12*r12);
  F[1] += f12 * d12; F[2] -= f12 * d12;
  return F;
}

fn min_pair_sep(r: array<vec2<f32>, 3>) -> f32 {
  return min(length(r[1] - r[0]),
        min(length(r[2] - r[0]),
            length(r[2] - r[1])));
}

fn project_com(s: ptr<function, State>) {
  let m = (*s).m; let M = m.x + m.y + m.z;
  let R = (m.x*(*s).r[0] + m.y*(*s).r[1] + m.z*(*s).r[2]) / M;
  let P = (*s).p[0] + (*s).p[1] + (*s).p[2];
  (*s).r[0] -= R; (*s).r[1] -= R; (*s).r[2] -= R;
  (*s).p[0] -= P * (m.x/M);
  (*s).p[1] -= P * (m.y/M);
  (*s).p[2] -= P * (m.z/M);
}

fn substep_count(rmin: f32, knobs: SimUniforms) -> u32 {
  let raw = u32(ceil(pow(knobs.r_sub / max(rmin, EPS_BOLT), knobs.gamma_sub)));
  return clamp(raw, 1u, knobs.N_max);
}

// One macro KDK step with adaptive substepping. Returns the substep count
// for telemetry.
fn kdk_macro_step(s: ptr<function, State>, knobs: SimUniforms) -> u32 {
  let rmin = min_pair_sep((*s).r);
  let nsub = substep_count(rmin, knobs);
  let dt   = knobs.dt_macro / f32(nsub);

  for (var i = 0u; i < nsub; i = i + 1u) {
    var F = pairwise_force((*s).m, (*s).r);
    (*s).p[0] += F[0] * (dt * 0.5);
    (*s).p[1] += F[1] * (dt * 0.5);
    (*s).p[2] += F[2] * (dt * 0.5);

    (*s).r[0] += (*s).p[0] * (dt / (*s).m.x);
    (*s).r[1] += (*s).p[1] * (dt / (*s).m.y);
    (*s).r[2] += (*s).p[2] * (dt / (*s).m.z);

    F = pairwise_force((*s).m, (*s).r);
    (*s).p[0] += F[0] * (dt * 0.5);
    (*s).p[1] += F[1] * (dt * 0.5);
    (*s).p[2] += F[2] * (dt * 0.5);
  }

  (*s).t += knobs.dt_macro;
  project_com(s);
  return nsub;
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersevents.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/events.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/events.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersevents.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
struct EventOut {
  fired:   bool,
  kind:    u32,                 // 1=collision, 2=escape, 3=max_substeps, 4=sim_failed
  pair:    u32,                 // for collision
  body:    u32,                 // for escape
};

fn collision_check(r: array<vec2<f32>, 3>, r_coll: f32) -> EventOut {
  var out: EventOut;
  out.fired = false;
  let d01 = length(r[1] - r[0]);
  let d02 = length(r[2] - r[0]);
  let d12 = length(r[2] - r[1]);
  let dmin = min(d01, min(d02, d12));
  if (dmin < r_coll) {
    out.fired = true; out.kind = 1u;
    if (d01 == dmin) { out.pair = 0u; }
    else if (d02 == dmin) { out.pair = 1u; }
    else { out.pair = 2u; }
  }
  return out;
}

struct EscapeCounters {
  c0: u32, c1: u32, c2: u32,
};

fn escape_tick(
  s: State, st: ptr<function, EscapeCounters>,
  R_esc: f32, k_esc: u32,
) -> EventOut {
  var out: EventOut; out.fired = false;
  // body 0 candidate
  let l0 = s.r[0] - (s.m.y * s.r[1] + s.m.z * s.r[2]) / (s.m.y + s.m.z);
  let v0 = s.p[0] / s.m.x
         - (s.p[1] + s.p[2]) / (s.m.y + s.m.z);
  let mu0 = s.m.x * (s.m.y + s.m.z);
  let pOut0 = mu0 * v0;
  let E0 = dot(pOut0, pOut0)/(2.0*mu0)
         - (s.m.x*(s.m.y+s.m.z)) / length(l0);
  let on0 = length(l0) > R_esc && dot(l0, v0) > 0.0 && E0 > 0.0;
  (*st).c0 = select(max((*st).c0, 1u) - 1u, min((*st).c0 + 1u, k_esc), on0);
  if ((*st).c0 >= k_esc) { out.fired = true; out.kind = 2u; out.body = 0u; return out; }

  // body 1
  let l1 = s.r[1] - (s.m.x * s.r[0] + s.m.z * s.r[2]) / (s.m.x + s.m.z);
  let v1 = s.p[1] / s.m.y
         - (s.p[0] + s.p[2]) / (s.m.x + s.m.z);
  let mu1 = s.m.y * (s.m.x + s.m.z);
  let pOut1 = mu1 * v1;
  let E1 = dot(pOut1, pOut1)/(2.0*mu1)
         - (s.m.y*(s.m.x+s.m.z)) / length(l1);
  let on1 = length(l1) > R_esc && dot(l1, v1) > 0.0 && E1 > 0.0;
  (*st).c1 = select(max((*st).c1, 1u) - 1u, min((*st).c1 + 1u, k_esc), on1);
  if ((*st).c1 >= k_esc) { out.fired = true; out.kind = 2u; out.body = 1u; return out; }

  // body 2
  let l2 = s.r[2] - (s.m.x * s.r[0] + s.m.y * s.r[1]) / (s.m.x + s.m.y);
  let v2 = s.p[2] / s.m.z
         - (s.p[0] + s.p[1]) / (s.m.x + s.m.y);
  let mu2 = s.m.z * (s.m.x + s.m.y);
  let pOut2 = mu2 * v2;
  let E2 = dot(pOut2, pOut2)/(2.0*mu2)
         - (s.m.z*(s.m.x+s.m.y)) / length(l2);
  let on2 = length(l2) > R_esc && dot(l2, v2) > 0.0 && E2 > 0.0;
  (*st).c2 = select(max((*st).c2, 1u) - 1u, min((*st).c2 + 1u, k_esc), on2);
  if ((*st).c2 >= k_esc) { out.fired = true; out.kind = 2u; out.body = 2u; return out; }

  return out;
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersobserve.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/observe.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/observe.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersobserve.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
fn total_energy(s: State) -> f32 {
  let K = dot(s.p[0], s.p[0]) / (2.0 * s.m.x)
        + dot(s.p[1], s.p[1]) / (2.0 * s.m.y)
        + dot(s.p[2], s.p[2]) / (2.0 * s.m.z);
  let U = -(s.m.x * s.m.y) / length(s.r[1] - s.r[0])
        - (s.m.x * s.m.z) / length(s.r[2] - s.r[0])
        - (s.m.y * s.m.z) / length(s.r[2] - s.r[1]);
  return K + U;
}

fn ang_mom(s: State) -> f32 {
  return s.r[0].x * s.p[0].y - s.r[0].y * s.p[0].x
       + s.r[1].x * s.p[1].y - s.r[1].y * s.p[1].x
       + s.r[2].x * s.p[2].y - s.r[2].y * s.p[2].x;
}

// Corrected shape-sphere coordinate (spec §4.3.1, post-revisions).
fn shape_sphere(rho_t: vec2<f32>, lambda_t: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let rho_sq    = dot(rho_t,    rho_t);
  let lambda_sq = dot(lambda_t, lambda_t);
  let I = rho_sq + lambda_sq;
  return vec3<f32>(
    (lambda_sq - rho_sq) / I,
    -2.0 * dot(rho_t, lambda_t) / I,
     2.0 * cross_z(rho_t, lambda_t) / I,
  );
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushaderssimulate.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/simulate.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/simulate.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushaderssimulate.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
struct SimUniforms {
  m:                vec3<f32>,
  M_total:          f32,
  G:                f32,
  dt_macro:         f32,
  N_max:            u32,
  r_sub:            f32,
  gamma_sub:        f32,
  T_horizon:        f32,
  r_coll:           f32,
  R_esc:            f32,
  k_esc:            u32,
  eps_E:            f32,
  eps_L:            f32,
  r_close:          f32,
  quality_tier:     u32,
  checkpoint_count: u32,
  samples_per_axis: u32,
  // For M3 we hard-code mu_max, alpha_min, q_max: they live with the chart in M10.
  // Rough values for the latent chart at M3:
  mu_max:           f32,           // = 5
  alpha_min:        f32,           // = 0.05
  q_max:            f32,           // = 2
};

struct TileRequest {
  z: i32, tx: i32, ty: i32, level: i32,
  uv_centre: vec2<f32>,
  uv_half:   vec2<f32>,
  flags:     u32,
};

struct SimResult {
  // Layout matches src/gpu/structs.ts. M = 8 here.
  n_checkpoints: array<vec4<f32>, 8>,
  free_group_word: vec4<u32>,
  arc_length_n:    f32,
  t_end:           f32,
  d_min:           f32,
  ftle:            f32,
  energy_drift:    f32,
  diffusion:       f32,
  delta_E_max_abs: f32,
  Lz_drift:        f32,
  delta_Lz_max_abs:f32,
  E_0:             f32,
  Lz_0:            f32,
  sample_descriptor: u32,
  trajectory_stats:  u32,
};

struct ICDescriptor {
  m1: f32, m2: f32, m3: f32, q_mass: f32,
  rho1_mag: f32, rho2_mag: f32, rho_ratio: f32, rho_angle: f32,
  K_0: f32, V_0: f32, virial_ratio: f32, r_min_pair_0: f32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform>      uniforms : SimUniforms;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform>      tile_req : TileRequest;
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> results : array<SimResult>;
@group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read_write> ics     : array<ICDescriptor>;

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn simulate(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid : vec3<u32>) {
  let N = uniforms.samples_per_axis;
  if (gid.x >= N || gid.y >= N) { return; }
  let idx = gid.y * N + gid.x;

  // Tile-local UV → latent z (M3: latent chart, both axes are z[0] and z[1]).
  let t = (vec2<f32>(f32(gid.x), f32(gid.y)) + 0.5) / f32(N);
  let uv = tile_req.uv_centre + tile_req.uv_half * (2.0 * t - 1.0);
  // Map UV → 8D latent. For M3 we use a default slice: u → z[0], v → z[1].
  var z: array<f32, 8>;
  z[0] = (uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0) * 3.0;     // ±3 latent range
  z[1] = (uv.y * 2.0 - 1.0) * 3.0;
  z[2] = 0.0; z[3] = 0.0; z[4] = 0.0; z[5] = 0.0;       // rest start
  z[6] = 0.0; z[7] = 0.0;                               // equal masses

  // Decode.
  let ic_out = decode_full(z, uniforms);

  if (ic_out.terminal != 0u) {
    write_terminal(idx, ic_out);
    return;
  }

  var s: State;
  s.r = ic_out.r; s.p = ic_out.p; s.m = ic_out.m; s.t = 0.0;

  // Initial invariants.
  let E0  = total_energy(s);
  let Lz0 = ang_mom(s);

  // Integration loop with checkpointing.
  var checkpoints: array<vec4<f32>, 8>;
  let M = uniforms.checkpoint_count;
  let dtCkpt = uniforms.T_horizon / f32(M);
  var nextCkpt: f32 = dtCkpt;
  var ck: u32 = 0u;

  var dE_max: f32 = 0.0; var dLz_max: f32 = 0.0;
  var dmin: f32 = 1e9;   var totalSubsteps: u32 = 0u;
  var maxSub: u32 = 0u;
  var escapeState = EscapeCounters(0u, 0u, 0u);

  var terminal_kind: u32 = 0u;
  var terminal_detail: u32 = 0u;
  var max_substeps_runs: u32 = 0u;

  loop {
    if (s.t >= uniforms.T_horizon) { break; }
    let nsub = kdk_macro_step(&s, uniforms);
    totalSubsteps += nsub;
    maxSub = max(maxSub, nsub);

    // Energy / Lz drift tracking.
    let E  = total_energy(s);
    let Lz = ang_mom(s);
    dE_max  = max(dE_max,  abs(E  - E0));
    dLz_max = max(dLz_max, abs(Lz - Lz0));

    let rmin = min(length(s.r[1]-s.r[0]),
              min(length(s.r[2]-s.r[0]), length(s.r[2]-s.r[1])));
    dmin = min(dmin, rmin);

    // Checkpoint capture (corrected shape-sphere coordinate).
    if (ck < M && s.t >= nextCkpt) {
      // Rebuild the canonical-frame Jacobi vectors for the shape sphere.
      let M01 = s.m.x + s.m.y;
      let cx  = (s.m.x*s.r[0] + s.m.y*s.r[1]) / M01;
      let rho = s.r[1] - s.r[0];
      let lambda = s.r[2] - cx;
      let muRho    = (s.m.x * s.m.y) / M01;
      let muLambda = s.m.z * M01;
      let rho_t    = rho    * sqrt(muRho);
      let lambda_t = lambda * sqrt(muLambda);
      let n = shape_sphere(rho_t, lambda_t);
      // .w = unwrapped phase placeholder for M6; M3 leaves it 0.
      checkpoints[ck] = vec4<f32>(n, 0.0);
      ck += 1u;
      nextCkpt += dtCkpt;
    }

    if (nsub >= uniforms.N_max) { max_substeps_runs += 1u; }
    else                         { max_substeps_runs = 0u; }
    if (max_substeps_runs >= 1u) {
      terminal_kind = 3u; break;
    }

    let coll = collision_check(s.r, uniforms.r_coll);
    if (coll.fired) { terminal_kind = 1u; terminal_detail = coll.pair; break; }

    let esc = escape_tick(s, &escapeState, uniforms.R_esc, uniforms.k_esc);
    if (esc.fired) { terminal_kind = 2u; terminal_detail = esc.body; break; }
  }

  // Fill any remaining checkpoints with the last-known n (so downstream
  // readers don't see uninitialised lanes).
  for (var k = ck; k < M; k = k + 1u) {
    checkpoints[k] = checkpoints[max(ck, 1u) - 1u];
  }

  // Write SimResult.
  var r: SimResult;
  r.n_checkpoints   = checkpoints;
  r.free_group_word = vec4<u32>(0u, 0u, 0u, 0u);     // M6
  r.arc_length_n    = 0.0;                            // M6
  r.t_end           = s.t;
  r.d_min           = dmin;
  r.ftle            = 0.0;                            // M6 / Research tier
  r.diffusion       = -1.0;                           // M6
  r.delta_E_max_abs = dE_max;
  r.energy_drift    = dE_max / max(abs(E0), uniforms.eps_E);
  r.delta_Lz_max_abs = dLz_max;
  r.Lz_drift         = dLz_max / max(abs(Lz0), uniforms.eps_L);
  r.E_0  = E0; r.Lz_0 = Lz0;
  r.sample_descriptor = (terminal_kind & 0x7u)
                       | ((terminal_detail & 0x3u) << 3u);
  r.trajectory_stats  = 0u;
  results[idx] = r;

  // Write IC descriptor.
  var d: ICDescriptor;
  d.m1 = ic_out.m.x; d.m2 = ic_out.m.y; d.m3 = ic_out.m.z;
  d.q_mass = min(ic_out.m.x, min(ic_out.m.y, ic_out.m.z));
  let M01_d = ic_out.m.x + ic_out.m.y;
  let cx_d  = (ic_out.m.x*ic_out.r[0] + ic_out.m.y*ic_out.r[1]) / M01_d;
  let rho_d    = ic_out.r[1] - ic_out.r[0];
  let lambda_d = ic_out.r[2] - cx_d;
  d.rho1_mag = length(rho_d);
  d.rho2_mag = length(lambda_d);
  d.rho_ratio = d.rho2_mag / max(d.rho1_mag, EPS_BOLT);
  d.rho_angle = atan2(cross_z(rho_d, lambda_d), dot(rho_d, lambda_d));
  let K0d = dot(ic_out.p[0], ic_out.p[0]) / (2.0*ic_out.m.x)
          + dot(ic_out.p[1], ic_out.p[1]) / (2.0*ic_out.m.y)
          + dot(ic_out.p[2], ic_out.p[2]) / (2.0*ic_out.m.z);
  d.K_0 = K0d;
  d.V_0 = E0 - K0d;
  d.virial_ratio = 2.0 * d.K_0 / max(EPS_BOLT, abs(d.V_0));
  d.r_min_pair_0 = min(length(ic_out.r[1]-ic_out.r[0]),
                  min(length(ic_out.r[2]-ic_out.r[0]),
                      length(ic_out.r[2]-ic_out.r[1])));
  ics[idx] = d;
}

fn write_terminal(idx: u32, ic: ICOut) {
  var r: SimResult;
  r.t_end = 0.0;
  r.d_min = 0.0;
  r.diffusion = -1.0;
  r.sample_descriptor = (1u & 0x7u);     // collision class
  results[idx] = r;
  // (descriptor still written for visualisation purposes.)
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersrender_layer0.wgsl}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/render\_layer0.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/render\_layer0.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersrender_layer0.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
// Minimal Layer-0 fragment shader: full-screen triangle, colour by outcome.

struct SimResult { /* same as in simulate.wgsl */ };
struct SimUniforms { /* same */ };

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> uniforms : SimUniforms;
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> results : array<SimResult>;

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vid : u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4<f32> {
  // One big triangle covering the screen.
  let pos = array<vec2<f32>, 3>(
    vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(3.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 3.0));
  return vec4<f32>(pos[vid], 0.0, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(@builtin(position) frag : vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
  let N = uniforms.samples_per_axis;
  // For Layer 0 the tile fills the viewport. Map fragment.xy to sample idx.
  // Assume we're rendering to a square canvas of side N * tile_pix; in M3
  // we use one tile = canvas, and the fragment-to-sample mapping is just
  // floor(fragment.xy / tile_pix).
  let tile_pix = 32.0;                  // arbitrary, matches our test render
  let sx = u32(floor(frag.x / tile_pix));
  let sy = u32(floor(frag.y / tile_pix));
  let idx = clamp(sy * N + sx, 0u, N*N - 1u);
  let r = results[idx];
  let cls = r.sample_descriptor & 0x7u;

  var rgb: vec3<f32>;
  if (cls == 0u) { rgb = vec3<f32>(0.7, 0.7, 0.2); }      // bounded / not-yet-classified
  else if (cls == 1u) { rgb = vec3<f32>(0.9, 0.1, 0.1); } // collision
  else if (cls == 2u) { rgb = vec3<f32>(0.1, 0.4, 0.9); } // escape
  else if (cls == 3u) { rgb = vec3<f32>(0.5, 0.5, 0.5); } // degenerate
  else                { rgb = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.9, 0.0); } // timeout / max_substeps

  return vec4<f32>(rgb, 1.0);
}
\end{verbatim}

\NormalTok{export interface DecodedSimResult \{}
\NormalTok{  n\_checkpoints}\OperatorTok{:}   \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ \{ x}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ y}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ z}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}[]}\OperatorTok{;}

\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{decodeBuffer}\NormalTok{(ab}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ ArrayBuffer}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ N}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ M}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ DecodedSimResult[] \{}
\NormalTok{  const stride }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{sizeOfSimResult}\NormalTok{(M)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const out}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ DecodedSimResult[] }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{Array}\NormalTok{(N }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ N)}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{for}\NormalTok{ (let i }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ i }\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{ N }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ N}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ i}\OperatorTok{++}\NormalTok{) \{}
\NormalTok{    const off }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ i }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ stride}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const f32 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{Float32Array}\NormalTok{(ab}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ off}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ stride }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const u32 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{Uint32Array}\NormalTok{(ab}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ off}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ stride }\OperatorTok{/} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{    const ck}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ \{ x}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ y}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ z}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \}[] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{for}\NormalTok{ (let m }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ m }\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{ M}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ m}\OperatorTok{++}\NormalTok{) \{}
\NormalTok{      const o }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ m }\OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{      ck}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{push}\NormalTok{(\{ x}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ f32[o]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ y}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ f32[o}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ z}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ f32[o}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ f32[o}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{] \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    \}}
\NormalTok{    const base }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ M }\OperatorTok{*} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    out[i] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{      n\_checkpoints}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ ck}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      free\_group\_word}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [u32[base]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ u32[base}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ u32[base}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ u32[base}\OperatorTok{+}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{]]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      arc\_length\_n}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{    f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      t\_end}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{           f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      d\_min}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{           f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{6}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      ftle}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{            f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{7}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      energy\_drift}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{    f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{8}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      diffusion}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{       f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{9}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      delta\_E\_max\_abs}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      Lz\_drift}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{        f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{11}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      delta\_Lz\_max\_abs}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{12}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      E\_0}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{             f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{13}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      Lz\_0}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{            f32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{14}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      sample\_descriptor}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ u32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{15}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      trajectory\_stats}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{  u32[base }\OperatorTok{+} \DecValTok{16}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{    \}}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \}}
\NormalTok{  return out}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{                     r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{terminal}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{kind} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ESCAPE\textquotesingle{}}    \OperatorTok{?} \DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{:}
\NormalTok{                     r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{terminal}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{kind} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}BOUNDED\textquotesingle{}}   \OperatorTok{?} \DecValTok{0} \OperatorTok{:}
\NormalTok{                     r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{terminal}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{kind} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}DEGENERATE\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{?} \DecValTok{3} \OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{        \}}
        \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (}\FunctionTok{classOf}\NormalTok{(gpuResults[idx]}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{sample\_descriptor}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{===}\NormalTok{ cpuClass) agree}\OperatorTok{++;}
\NormalTok{      \}}
\NormalTok{    \}}

    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(agree)}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeGreaterThanOrEqual}\NormalTok{(N}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{N }\OperatorTok{{-}} \DecValTok{6}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}   \CommentTok{// allow 6 borderline disagreements}
\NormalTok{  \}}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{120\_000}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\})}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{run-it-3}{%
\section{Run it}\label{run-it-3}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/unit/gpu}
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/layer0}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\hypertarget{acceptance-check-3}{%
\section{Acceptance check}\label{acceptance-check-3}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/layer0\_gpu\_vs\_cpu}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

If that returns green with at least 250 of 256 samples in agreement, M3
is done. The remaining \textasciitilde6 samples-of-disagreement budget
covers \texttt{f32} vs \texttt{f64} divergence right on basin boundaries
--- that's expected and what the adaptive refinement in M5 will correct
for.

\hypertarget{notes-for-the-implementer-1}{%
\section{Notes for the implementer}\label{notes-for-the-implementer-1}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Shader concatenation.} \texttt{concatShaders()} glues the WGSL
  files together in the order required for forward declarations. In
  production, prefer a proper preprocessor or \texttt{wgsl-link}; for
  the test gate, plain string concat is enough.
\item
  \textbf{Headless WebGPU.} The integration test skips if
  \texttt{navigator.gpu} is absent. To run it locally you need either a
  Chrome 113+ environment with WebGPU enabled, or the
  \texttt{@webgpu/types} + \texttt{dawn}-via-Node setup. CI
  configurations are out of scope for M3 --- circle back when M5 needs
  CI budget gates.
\item
  \textbf{M3 hard-coding.} The M3 shader hard-codes \texttt{mu\_max},
  \texttt{alpha\_min}, \texttt{q\_max} as additional fields of
  \texttt{SimUniforms}. M10 promotes these to per-chart parameters; M3's
  contract is just ``the latent chart works''.
\item
  \textbf{Single tile = viewport.} The M3 fragment shader hard-codes
  \texttt{tile\_pix\ =\ 32}. Once Layer 1 (M4) introduces real tiles and
  the cache, this becomes a per-tile uniform.
\end{itemize}

\newpage

\hypertarget{m4-layer-1-tile-cache-and-ancestor-fallback}{%
\chapter{M4 --- Layer 1: tile cache and ancestor
fallback}\label{m4-layer-1-tile-cache-and-ancestor-fallback}}

\hypertarget{goal-4}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-4}}

The slippy-map UX. A tile cache keyed by \texttt{TileCacheKey}, a
quadtree pyramid, ancestor walking with upscaling, and a FIFO compute
queue. After M4, panning and zooming never produce a blank frame:
missing children are stretched from the nearest cached ancestor while
the compute queue drains in the background.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/layer1}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

A scripted pan that scrolls four screens of content across a 1024²
viewport produces zero frames with a blank region. A zoom step shows a
stretched parent for exactly one frame, then sharp children once they
land.

\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ Lifecycle }\OperatorTok{=}
  \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}unseen\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}queued\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}computing\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ready\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}readyRefinable\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{notes-for-the-implementer-2}{%
\section{Notes for the implementer}\label{notes-for-the-implementer-2}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Where this connects to Layer 0.} The \texttt{dispatch\_layer0}
  call from M3 becomes the per-tile body of the loop here: each compute
  job pulls a \texttt{TileID} off the queue, fills \texttt{uv\_centre}
  and \texttt{uv\_half} from \texttt{tileCentreHalf(id)}, allocates a
  fresh \texttt{simBuffer} / \texttt{icBuffer}, and dispatches the M3
  compute pipeline. The fragment shader for the full-screen render uses
  \texttt{subrect} to position the per-tile texture (or, for stretched
  ancestors, samples the ancestor's storage buffer directly with the
  \texttt{subrect} offset and scale).
\item
  \textbf{The \texttt{mag} field of TileCacheKey} is the affine slice's
  half-width-in-latent-space, not the tile's UV half. The viewport's UV
  position determines \texttt{uv\_centre} / \texttt{uv\_half} per tile,
  but the latent geometry (\texttt{z0}, \texttt{q1}, \texttt{q2},
  \texttt{mag}) is shared across all tiles in the same view.
\item
  \textbf{Cache size.} The default 64-slot cache holds about 64 × 16 KB
  ≈ 1 MB of \texttt{SimResult} data at \texttt{M=8} and \texttt{N=16}.
  Adjust capacity to whatever the device's \texttt{maxBufferSize}
  allows; M5 introduces weighted eviction so expensive boundary tiles
  stay resident even under pressure.
\item
  \textbf{The \texttt{inflight} protection in \texttt{evictOne()}} is
  the only place where the M4 cache departs from pure LRU. A tile
  mid-dispatch must not have its \texttt{simBuffer} destroyed; the first
  eviction-eligible tile is chosen instead. With the default capacity
  and a steady-state of 4 in-flight jobs this is invisible. Under
  pathological eviction pressure the cache may run beyond
  \texttt{capacity}; M5's weighted variant fixes this.
\end{itemize}

\newpage

\hypertarget{m5-layer-2-gpu-reduction-adaptive-refinement}{%
\chapter{M5 --- Layer 2: GPU reduction + adaptive
refinement}\label{m5-layer-2-gpu-reduction-adaptive-refinement}}

\hypertarget{goal-5}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-5}}

Tile-level decisions become data-driven. The GPU reduces
\texttt{SimResult{[}N²{]}} into a 272-byte \texttt{TileReduction} per
tile, the CPU reads it back, scores coherence, and decides what to
split. Compute budget concentrates at fractal boundaries; uniform basin
interiors stay coarse.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/layer2}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

A uniform-basin tile has \texttt{coherence\_score\ ≤\ 0.05} and is never
split below depth 4 with budget unbounded. A fractal-boundary tile
splits all the way to \texttt{MAX\_DEPTH}. Off-screen tiles are
cancelled before dispatch.

\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ CachedTile}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Lifecycle \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Allowed transitions. Anything not listed is a bug.}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ *   unseen        → queued}
\CommentTok{ *   queued        → computing | unseen (cancel)}
\CommentTok{ *   computing     → ready | unseen (failure with no recovery)}
\CommentTok{ *   ready         → readyRefinable | unseen (eviction)}
\CommentTok{ *   readyRefinable → computing (split / re{-}dispatch) | unseen}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{const TRANSITIONS}\OperatorTok{:} \BuiltInTok{Record}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{Lifecycle}\OperatorTok{,} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ Lifecycle[]}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  unseen}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{         [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}queued\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  queued}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{         [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}computing\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}unseen\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  computing}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{      [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ready\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}     \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}unseen\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  ready}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{          [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}readyRefinable\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}unseen\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  readyRefinable}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}computing\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}unseen\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{canTransition}\NormalTok{(from}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Lifecycle}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ to}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Lifecycle)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{boolean}\NormalTok{ \{}

\CommentTok{/**}

\CommentTok{ * Active terms are zero{-}weighted when their respective metric is disabled}
\CommentTok{ * (FTLE, ensemble) so the formula is one expression in all tiers.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export const COHERENCE\_WEIGHTS }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  wn}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{1.0}\OperatorTok{,}    \CommentTok{// shape{-}trajectory spread (dominant)}
\NormalTok{  wL}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.20}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// arc{-}length spread}
\NormalTok{  wt}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.25}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// event{-}time spread}
\NormalTok{  wd}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.15}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// d\_min spread}
\NormalTok{  wf}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.20}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// FTLE spread (Research only)}
\NormalTok{  wD}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.25}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// diffusion spread}
\NormalTok{  wo}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.35}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// outcome impurity}
\NormalTok{  wE}\OperatorTok{:}    \FloatTok{0.30}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// suspect\_fraction (numerical unreliability)}
\NormalTok{  wLz}\OperatorTok{:}   \FloatTok{0.15}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// suspect\_lz\_fraction}
\NormalTok{  wens}\OperatorTok{:}  \FloatTok{0.25}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// ensemble disagreement}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * S\_tile = w\_n S\_n + ... + w\_ens S\_ens}
\CommentTok{ * C\_tile = 1 / (1 + S\_tile)}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Returns both. The caller may want either (S\_tile is monotone for}
\CommentTok{ * thresholding, C\_tile is bounded in [0,1] for blending).}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{compositeCoherence}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  r}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileReduction}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  modes}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ \{ ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ensembleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{boolean}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ \{ sTile}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ cTile}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \} \{}
\NormalTok{  const w }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ COHERENCE\_WEIGHTS}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const Sn   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_n}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const SL   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_arc\_length\_n}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const St   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_t\_end}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const Sd   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_d\_min}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const Sf   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ modes}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ftleEnabled}     \OperatorTok{?}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_ftle}      \OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const SD   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_diffusion} \OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=} \DecValTok{0} \OperatorTok{?}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{spread\_diffusion} \OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const So   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{outcome\_impurity}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const SE   }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{suspect\_fraction}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const SLz  }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{suspect\_lz\_fraction}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const Sens }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ modes}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ensembleEnabled}
    \OperatorTok{?} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{max}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ensemble\_outcome\_agreement}\NormalTok{)}
    \OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{  const sTile }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wn}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{Sn }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wL}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{SL }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wt}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{St }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wd}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{Sd}
              \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wf}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{Sf }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wD}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{SD }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wo}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{So}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ TileReduction \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./reduction\_types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{export interface SplitThresholds \{}
\NormalTok{  tauImpurity}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// outcome impurity force{-}split}
\NormalTok{  tauSuspect}\OperatorTok{:}         \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// suspect{-}sample force{-}split}
\NormalTok{  tau0}\OperatorTok{:}               \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// base τ(ℓ)}
\NormalTok{  tauPerLevel}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// slope}

\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export const DEFAULT\_THRESHOLDS}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ SplitThresholds }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  tauImpurity}\OperatorTok{:}        \FloatTok{0.10}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  tauSuspect}\OperatorTok{:}         \FloatTok{0.05}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  tau0}\OperatorTok{:}               \FloatTok{0.20}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  tauPerLevel}\OperatorTok{:}        \FloatTok{0.02}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  ensembleAgreementMin}\OperatorTok{:} \FloatTok{0.85}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{export interface SplitDecision \{}
\NormalTok{  action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}split\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}keep\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}merge\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  reason}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Decide whether to split, keep, or merge a tile. The order of the}
\CommentTok{ * checks matters: hard guards (depth, f32 floor, off{-}screen) override}
\CommentTok{ * everything; force{-}splits override coherence; coherence is the default.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{decideSplit}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  r}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileReduction}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  ctx}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{    level}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    maxDepth}\OperatorTok{:}     \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    visible}\OperatorTok{:}      \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    thresholds}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{   SplitThresholds}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:}  \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    ensembleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \}}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ SplitDecision \{}
  \CommentTok{// Hard guards.}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (}\OperatorTok{!}\NormalTok{ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{visible}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}merge\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}off\_screen\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{status\_flags} \OperatorTok{\&}\NormalTok{ TILE\_STATUS}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{AT\_F32\_FLOOR}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}keep\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}f32\_floor\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{level} \OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{maxDepth}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}keep\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}max\_depth\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}

  \CommentTok{// Force splits.}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{outcome\_impurity} \OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thresholds}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{tauImpurity}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}split\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}outcome\_impurity\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{suspect\_fraction} \OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thresholds}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{tauSuspect}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}split\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}suspect\_fraction\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ensembleEnabled}
      \OperatorTok{\&\&}\NormalTok{ r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ensemble\_outcome\_agreement} \OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thresholds}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ensembleAgreementMin}\NormalTok{)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}split\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ensemble\_disagreement\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}

  \CommentTok{// Coherence{-}driven split.}
\NormalTok{  const tau }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thresholds}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{tau0} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thresholds}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{tauPerLevel} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{level}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (r}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{coherence\_score} \OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ tau)}
\NormalTok{    return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}split\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}coherence\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{  return \{ action}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}keep\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reason}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}coherent\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \}}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}
\end{Highlighting}

\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ CachedTile \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Weighted{-}LRU score. A tile that took 100 ms to compute is worth \textasciitilde{}25× a}
\CommentTok{ * tile that took 4 ms; we don\textquotesingle{}t want to throw away the expensive one}
\CommentTok{ * just because it was used a moment longer ago.}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Score = lastUsed {-} α · log(1 + computeCostMs)}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Lower score → more evictable. α = 4 by default — empirically chosen so}

\CommentTok{ * 1 ms tile.}

\NormalTok{  return t}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{lastUsed} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ alpha }\OperatorTok{*} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{log}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ t}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{computeCostMs}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/** Pick the tile with the smallest eviction score, skipping computing}
\CommentTok{ *  tiles. Returns null if no eligible tile exists. */}

\NormalTok{  alpha }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [}\DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ CachedTile] }\OperatorTok{|} \DataTypeTok{null}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  let chosen}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [}\DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ CachedTile] }\OperatorTok{|} \DataTypeTok{null} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ null}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  let chosenScore }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ Infinity}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{for}\NormalTok{ (const entry of tiles) \{}
\NormalTok{    const t }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ entry[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (t}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{lifecycle} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}computing\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{) continue}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const s }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{evictionScore}\NormalTok{(t}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ alpha)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (s }\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{ chosenScore) \{ chosen }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ entry}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ chosenScore }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ s}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ \}}
\NormalTok{  \}}
\NormalTok{  return chosen}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export interface SchedulerOpts \{}
\NormalTok{  frameBudget}\OperatorTok{:}    \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}       \CommentTok{// max compute jobs to launch this frame}
\NormalTok{  maxInFlight}\OperatorTok{:}    \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}       \CommentTok{// jobs already running}
\NormalTok{  ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:}    \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export interface FrameJob \{}
\NormalTok{  id}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{        TileID}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  priority}\OperatorTok{:}  \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  parent}\OperatorTok{?:}\NormalTok{   TileID}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Pure{-}CPU pass that the renderer wraps a GPU dispatch loop around. It:}
\CommentTok{ *   1. Lists visible tiles at the desired depth.}
\CommentTok{ *   2. For each missing tile, walks ancestors to draw a fallback.}
\CommentTok{ *   3. Computes priority for every visible tile and every candidate}
\CommentTok{ *      child of a refinable tile.}
