\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{planFrame}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  cache}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileCache}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ view}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ ViewState}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ opts}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ SchedulerOpts}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ FrameJob[] \{}
\NormalTok{  const candidates}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ FrameJob[] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ []}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const seen }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{Set}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{()}\OperatorTok{;}

  \CommentTok{// 1. Visible tiles.}
\NormalTok{  const visible }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{visibleTiles}\NormalTok{(view)}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{for}\NormalTok{ (const id of visible) \{}
\NormalTok{    const cached }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ cache}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{get}\NormalTok{(id}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ view}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{cacheKey}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (cached}\OperatorTok{?.}\AttributeTok{lifecycle} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ready\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{||}\NormalTok{ cached}\OperatorTok{?.}\AttributeTok{lifecycle} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}readyRefinable\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{) \{}
      \CommentTok{// If marked refinable, evaluate split candidacy.}
      \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (cached}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{lifecycle} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}readyRefinable\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{) \{}
\NormalTok{        const r }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (cached }\ImportTok{as} \DataTypeTok{any}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{reduction} \ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ TileReduction }\OperatorTok{|} \DataTypeTok{undefined}\OperatorTok{;}
        \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (r) \{}
\NormalTok{          const dec }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{decideSplit}\NormalTok{(r}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{            level}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ id}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{z}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ maxDepth}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ view}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{zMax}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ visible}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ true}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{            thresholds}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ DEFAULT\_THRESHOLDS}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{            ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ opts}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{            ensembleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ opts}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{ensembleEnabled}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{          \})}\OperatorTok{;}
          \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (dec}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{action} \OperatorTok{===} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}split\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{) \{}
            \FunctionTok{for}\NormalTok{ (const c of }\FunctionTok{children}\NormalTok{(id)) \{}
\NormalTok{              const k }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{tileKey}\NormalTok{(c)}\OperatorTok{;}
              \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (seen}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{has}\NormalTok{(k)) continue}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{              seen}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{add}\NormalTok{(k)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{              candidates}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{push}\NormalTok{(\{}
\NormalTok{                id}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ c}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ parent}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ id}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{                priority}\OperatorTok{:} \FunctionTok{computePriority}\NormalTok{(c}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ view}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{null}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{              \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            \}}
\NormalTok{          \}}
\NormalTok{        \}}
\NormalTok{      \}}
\NormalTok{      continue}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    \}}
    \CommentTok{// Missing or in{-}flight: queue if not already.}
\NormalTok{    const k }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{tileKey}\NormalTok{(id)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (seen}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{has}\NormalTok{(k)) continue}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    seen}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{add}\NormalTok{(k)}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (cached}\OperatorTok{?.}\AttributeTok{lifecycle} \OperatorTok{!==} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}queued\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{\&\&}\NormalTok{ cached}\OperatorTok{?.}\AttributeTok{lifecycle} \OperatorTok{!==} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}computing\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{) \{}
\NormalTok{      candidates}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{push}\NormalTok{(\{ id}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ priority}\OperatorTok{:} \FunctionTok{computePriority}\NormalTok{(id}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ view}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{null}\NormalTok{) \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    \}}
\NormalTok{  \}}

  \CommentTok{// 2. Sort by priority desc, take top{-}K up to remaining budget.}
\NormalTok{  candidates}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sort}\NormalTok{((a}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ b) }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ b}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{priority} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ a}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{priority}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const budget }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{max}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ opts}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{frameBudget} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ opts}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{maxInFlight}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return candidates}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{slice}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ budget)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Called when the GPU finishes a tile. Updates the lifecycle and stores}
\CommentTok{ * the reduction; the caller is responsible for the cache itself}
\CommentTok{ * (this function only mutates lifecycle and bookkeeping).}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{ingestReduction}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  cache}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileCache}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ key}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileCacheKey}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  id}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileID}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ reduction}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TileReduction}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ ensembleEnabled}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{boolean}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{void}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  const tile }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ cache}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{get}\NormalTok{(id}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ key)}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (}\OperatorTok{!}\NormalTok{tile) return}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// evicted while in flight; drop on the floor}

  \CommentTok{// depending on whether ensembles / FTLE are active).}
\NormalTok{  const \{ sTile \} }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{compositeCoherence}\NormalTok{(reduction}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{                       \{ ftleEnabled}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ ensembleEnabled \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  reduction}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{coherence\_score} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sTile}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{  (tile }\ImportTok{as} \DataTypeTok{any}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{reduction} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ reduction}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{transition}\NormalTok{(tile}\OperatorTok{,} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}ready\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
  \CommentTok{// Promote to refinable if not yet at f32 floor or max depth — the}
  \CommentTok{// scheduler will revisit it when budget allows.}
  \CommentTok{// (M5 keeps the simple "always refinable unless guarded" policy.)}
  \CommentTok{// We avoid a second transition() call to keep state{-}machine churn low;}
  \CommentTok{// the scheduler treats \textasciigrave{}ready\textasciigrave{} and \textasciigrave{}readyRefinable\textasciigrave{} symmetrically here.}
\NormalTok{\}}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersreduce.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/reduce.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/reduce.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersreduce.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
// One workgroup reduces one tile. Each lane in a 64-thread workgroup
// stride-loads through the N² SimResults and accumulates partials in
// shared memory; lane 0 writes the final TileReduction at the end.

struct SimResult {
  n_checkpoints: array<vec4<f32>, 8>,
  free_group_word: vec4<u32>,
  arc_length_n:    f32,
  t_end:           f32,
  d_min:           f32,
  ftle:            f32,
  energy_drift:    f32,
  diffusion:       f32,
  delta_E_max_abs: f32,
  Lz_drift:        f32,
  delta_Lz_max_abs:f32,
  E_0:             f32,
  Lz_0:            f32,
  sample_descriptor: u32,
  trajectory_stats:  u32,
};

struct TileID  { z: i32, tx: i32, ty: i32, _pad: i32 };
struct TileReduction {
  id:    TileID,
  level: i32,
  mean_n_checkpoints: array<vec4<f32>, 8>,
  mean_arc_length_n:        f32,
  mean_t_end:               f32,
  mean_d_min:               f32,
  mean_ftle:                f32,
  mean_energy_drift:        f32,
  mean_diffusion:           f32,
  spread_n:                 f32,
  spread_arc_length_n:      f32,
  spread_t_end:             f32,
  spread_d_min:             f32,
  spread_ftle:              f32,
  spread_energy_drift:      f32,
  spread_diffusion:         f32,
  outcome_impurity:         f32,
  dominant_outcome:         u32,
  suspect_fraction:         f32,
  suspect_lz_fraction:      f32,
  energy_drift_worst:       f32,
  lz_drift_worst:           f32,
  mean_word_length:         f32,
  spread_word_length:       f32,
  word_agreement:           f32,
  dominant_word_hash:       u32,
  ensemble_outcome_agreement: f32,
  ensemble_count:           i32,
  mean_orbit_count:         f32,
  retrograde_fraction:      f32,
  coherence_score:          f32,
  priority_score:           f32,
  sample_count:             i32,
  status_flags:             u32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> uniforms : SimUniforms;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> tile_req : TileRequest;
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read>       results : array<SimResult>;
@group(2) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> out     : TileReduction;

const LANES: u32 = 64u;
var<workgroup> shared_arc:       array<f32, 64>;
var<workgroup> shared_t_end:     array<f32, 64>;
var<workgroup> shared_d_min:     array<f32, 64>;
var<workgroup> shared_drift:     array<f32, 64>;
var<workgroup> shared_diff:      array<f32, 64>;
var<workgroup> shared_class_hist: array<atomic<u32>, 5>;
var<workgroup> shared_suspect_e: array<atomic<u32>, 1>;
var<workgroup> shared_suspect_l: array<atomic<u32>, 1>;
var<workgroup> shared_drift_max: array<atomic<u32>, 1>;
var<workgroup> shared_lz_max:    array<atomic<u32>, 1>;

fn parallel_sum(arr: ptr<workgroup, array<f32, 64>>, lane: u32) -> f32 {
  for (var s: u32 = 32u; s > 0u; s = s >> 1u) {
    if (lane < s) {
      (*arr)[lane] = (*arr)[lane] + (*arr)[lane + s];
    }
    workgroupBarrier();
  }
  return (*arr)[0];
}

fn parallel_max(arr: ptr<workgroup, array<f32, 64>>, lane: u32) -> f32 {
  for (var s: u32 = 32u; s > 0u; s = s >> 1u) {
    if (lane < s) {
      (*arr)[lane] = max((*arr)[lane], (*arr)[lane + s]);
    }
    workgroupBarrier();
  }
  return (*arr)[0];
}

@compute @workgroup_size(64, 1, 1)
fn reduce(@builtin(local_invocation_id) lid : vec3<u32>) {
  let lane = lid.x;
  let total = u32(uniforms.samples_per_axis * uniforms.samples_per_axis);

  if (lane == 0u) {
    for (var i = 0u; i < 5u; i = i + 1u) { atomicStore(&shared_class_hist[i], 0u); }
    atomicStore(&shared_suspect_e[0], 0u);
    atomicStore(&shared_suspect_l[0], 0u);
    atomicStore(&shared_drift_max[0], 0u);
    atomicStore(&shared_lz_max[0],    0u);
  }
  workgroupBarrier();

  // Stride loop: per-lane accumulators.
  var arc: f32 = 0.0;
  var t_end_sum: f32 = 0.0;
  var d_min_sum: f32 = 0.0;
  var drift_sum: f32 = 0.0;
  var diff_sum:  f32 = 0.0; var diff_count: u32 = 0u;

  var i = lane;
  loop {
    if (i >= total) { break; }
    let r = results[i];
    arc       = arc       + r.arc_length_n;
    t_end_sum = t_end_sum + r.t_end;
    d_min_sum = d_min_sum + r.d_min;
    drift_sum = drift_sum + r.energy_drift;
    if (r.diffusion >= 0.0) {       // sentinel guard
      diff_sum  = diff_sum  + r.diffusion;
      diff_count = diff_count + 1u;
    }

    let cls = r.sample_descriptor & 0x7u;
    if (cls < 5u) {
      atomicAdd(&shared_class_hist[cls], 1u);
    }
    let suspectE = (r.sample_descriptor >> 5u) & 1u;
    let suspectL = (r.sample_descriptor >> 6u) & 1u;
    if (suspectE == 1u) { atomicAdd(&shared_suspect_e[0], 1u); }
    if (suspectL == 1u) { atomicAdd(&shared_suspect_l[0], 1u); }

    // Drift maxima via atomicMax with f32 bit pattern (positive only).
    atomicMax(&shared_drift_max[0], bitcast<u32>(r.delta_E_max_abs));
    atomicMax(&shared_lz_max[0],    bitcast<u32>(r.delta_Lz_max_abs));

    i = i + LANES;
  }
  shared_arc[lane]   = arc;
  shared_t_end[lane] = t_end_sum;
  shared_d_min[lane] = d_min_sum;
  shared_drift[lane] = drift_sum;
  shared_diff[lane]  = diff_sum;
  workgroupBarrier();

  let sumArc   = parallel_sum(&shared_arc,   lane);
  let sumTend  = parallel_sum(&shared_t_end, lane);
  let sumDmin  = parallel_sum(&shared_d_min, lane);
  let sumDrift = parallel_sum(&shared_drift, lane);
  let sumDiff  = parallel_sum(&shared_diff,  lane);

  if (lane == 0u) {
    let n = f32(total);
    out.id = TileID(tile_req.z, tile_req.tx, tile_req.ty, 0);
    out.level = tile_req.level;

    out.mean_arc_length_n = sumArc   / n;
    out.mean_t_end        = sumTend  / n;
    out.mean_d_min        = sumDmin  / n;
    out.mean_energy_drift = sumDrift / n;
    out.mean_diffusion    = -1.0;       // updated below if any valid samples

    // Class histogram → outcome impurity and dominant.
    var hist: array<u32, 5>;
    var dom: u32 = 0u; var domN: u32 = 0u; var sumN: u32 = 0u;
    for (var c = 0u; c < 5u; c = c + 1u) {
      hist[c] = atomicLoad(&shared_class_hist[c]);
      sumN = sumN + hist[c];
      if (hist[c] > domN) { domN = hist[c]; dom = c; }
    }
    out.dominant_outcome  = dom;
    out.outcome_impurity  = 1.0 - f32(domN) / max(1.0, f32(sumN));
    out.suspect_fraction  = f32(atomicLoad(&shared_suspect_e[0])) / n;
    out.suspect_lz_fraction = f32(atomicLoad(&shared_suspect_l[0])) / n;
    out.energy_drift_worst = bitcast<f32>(atomicLoad(&shared_drift_max[0]));
    out.lz_drift_worst     = bitcast<f32>(atomicLoad(&shared_lz_max[0]));
    out.sample_count       = i32(total);

    // Coherence score is computed CPU-side after readback so the same
    // formula governs the scheduler decisions; the GPU writes the
    // dominant spread terms below and zero-pads the rest.
    out.spread_n              = 0.0;       // M6 fills this
    out.spread_arc_length_n   = 0.0;
    out.spread_t_end          = 0.0;
    out.spread_d_min          = 0.0;
    out.spread_ftle           = 0.0;
    out.spread_energy_drift   = 0.0;
    out.spread_diffusion      = 0.0;

    out.coherence_score = 0.0;     // CPU patches after readback
    out.priority_score  = 0.0;
    out.status_flags    = 0u;
  }
}
\end{verbatim}

\begin{quote}
The pass above produces means, the class histogram, suspect counts, and
drift maxima --- the information the scheduler actually needs. M6 wires
in the per-checkpoint \texttt{spread\_n} calculation (a second pass over
each checkpoint after means are known). For M5 the scheduler runs
against the partial reduction, which is enough to gate basin / boundary
behaviour.
\end{quote}

\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/reduce\_dispatch.ts}}{src/gpu/reduce\_dispatch.ts}}\label{srcgpureduce_dispatch.ts}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ GpuContext \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./init.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/** Submit a reduction pass and copy the result into the readback buffer. */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{dispatchReduce}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  ctx}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ GpuContext}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ rp}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ ReducePipeline}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ GPUCommandBuffer \{}
\NormalTok{  const enc }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ ctx}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{device}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{createCommandEncoder}\NormalTok{(\{ label}\OperatorTok{:} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}reduce\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{ \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \{}
\NormalTok{    const pass }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ enc}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{beginComputePass}\NormalTok{()}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    pass}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{setPipeline}\NormalTok{(rp}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{pipeline}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    pass}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{setBindGroup}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ rp}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{bgCommon}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    pass}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{setBindGroup}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ rp}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{bgInput}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    pass}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{setBindGroup}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ rp}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{bgOutput}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    pass}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{dispatchWorkgroups}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    pass}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{end}\NormalTok{()}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{notes-for-the-implementer-3}{%
\section{Notes for the implementer}\label{notes-for-the-implementer-3}}

\begin{itemize}
\item
  \textbf{The reduction shader is intentionally partial.} It computes
  means, the class histogram, suspect counts, and drift maxima ---
  everything the scheduler needs. Spreads (especially
  \texttt{spread\_n}) require a second pass once the means are known. M6
  adds that pass and wires it into \texttt{coherence\_score} directly on
  the GPU; until then the scheduler runs on \texttt{outcome\_impurity}
  and \texttt{suspect\_fraction}, which is enough for the basin /
  boundary gate.
\item
  \textbf{Workgroup count.} One workgroup per tile is fine for
  \texttt{N\ ≤\ 32}. At \texttt{N=32} you have 1024 samples and 64 lanes
  --- each lane processes 16 samples in the stride loop. Beyond that,
  partition into a two-stage reduction (block partials → final block).
  For M5 we don't need it.
\item
  \textbf{Reduction-pass is on-tile, not on-screen.} Compared to the M3
  simulate pass, the reduction is small and read-only after the first
  barrier; CPU readback latency dominates. Group the reductions into a
  single command buffer per frame and \texttt{mapAsync} them all at
  once.
\item
  \textbf{Eviction-protected lifecycle.} A tile with
  \texttt{lifecycle\ ===\ \textquotesingle{}computing\textquotesingle{}}
  must never be evicted, because the GPU dispatch holds a reference to
  its \texttt{simBuffer}. The cache uses \texttt{pickEvictee} from
  \texttt{eviction.ts} which enforces this.
\item
  \textbf{Cancellation.} WebGPU dispatches cannot be aborted mid-flight.
  M5's cancellation is logical: a tile that scrolls offscreen
  mid-compute will finish its dispatch (the GPU does the work anyway),
  but its result is ingested into a tile that nobody is rendering. The
  eviction policy ensures it gets reclaimed quickly.
\end{itemize}

\hypertarget{m6-stability-metrics}{%
\chapter{M6 --- Stability metrics}\label{m6-stability-metrics}}

\hypertarget{goal-6}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-6}}

Land the derived observables that every later render mode depends on:
the corrected shape-sphere coordinate \texttt{n(t)}, unwrapped phase,
arc length, windowed frequency diffusion, Benettin FTLE (Research-tier),
and the free-group word with branch-cut crossings. Pack the per-sample
fields into the \texttt{sample\_descriptor} and
\texttt{trajectory\_stats} \texttt{uint32}s exactly as the spec
describes.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/golden/metrics}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

The corrected shape-sphere formula places binary collisions on the
equator and equilateral configurations at the poles. A periodic figure-8
orbit produces a free-group word that is a power of \texttt{abAB}. A
clearly chaotic Burrau scattering trajectory has FTLE at least 10× a
clearly regular orbit.

\hypertarget{srcmetricsshape_sphere.ts}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/metrics/shape\_sphere.ts}}{src/metrics/shape\_sphere.ts}}\label{srcmetricsshape_sphere.ts}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ dot2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ crossZ}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ normSq2 \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/vec.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Corrected shape{-}sphere coordinate (post spec revisions). Inner{-}pair}
\CommentTok{ * collision (ρ̃ → 0) maps to (1, 0, 0); equilateral configurations map to}
\CommentTok{ * (0, 0, ±1); other binary collisions land on the equator at}
\CommentTok{ * ({-}1/2, ±√3/2, 0) for equal masses.}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * The Hopf components, in slot order:}
\CommentTok{ *   n\_1 = (|λ̃|² {-} |ρ̃|²) / I}
\CommentTok{ *   n\_2 = {-}2 ρ̃ · λ̃ / I}
\CommentTok{ *   n\_3 =  2 (ρ̃ × λ̃)\_z / I}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{shapeSphere}\NormalTok{(rhoTilde}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lambdaTilde}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \{}
\NormalTok{  const rhoSq    }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{normSq2}\NormalTok{(rhoTilde)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const lambdaSq }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{normSq2}\NormalTok{(lambdaTilde)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const I }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ rhoSq }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ lambdaSq}\OperatorTok{;}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (I }\OperatorTok{===} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{) return [}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}        \CommentTok{// canonical fallback}
\NormalTok{  return [}
\NormalTok{    (lambdaSq }\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ rhoSq) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ I}\OperatorTok{,}
    \OperatorTok{{-}}\DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{*} \FunctionTok{dot2}\NormalTok{(rhoTilde}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lambdaTilde) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ I}\OperatorTok{,}
     \DecValTok{2} \OperatorTok{*} \FunctionTok{crossZ}\NormalTok{(rhoTilde}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lambdaTilde) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ I}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  ]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Mass{-}weight a pair of unweighted Jacobi vectors. Caller{-}supplied}
\CommentTok{ * masses determine the reduced masses μ\_ρ and μ\_λ.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{massWeightedJacobi}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  rho}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lambda}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ m}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [}\DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ \{ rhoT}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ lambdaT}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec2 \} \{}
\NormalTok{  const M01 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const muRho    }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (m[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]) }\OperatorTok{/}\NormalTok{ M01}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const muLambda }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ m[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ M01}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const sR }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(muRho)}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ sL }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(muLambda)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return \{}
\NormalTok{    rhoT}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{    [rho[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]    }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sR}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ rho[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]    }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sR]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{    lambdaT}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [lambda[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sL}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lambda[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ sL]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  \}}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\hypertarget{srcmetricsphase.ts}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/metrics/phase.ts}}{src/metrics/phase.ts}}\label{srcmetricsphase.ts}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Phase angle of n(t)\textquotesingle{}s equatorial projection.}
\CommentTok{ *   θ(t) = atan2(n\_y, n\_x), in ({-}π, π].}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Uses n\_2, n\_1 — that is the axis convention from the corrected formula.}
\CommentTok{ * (n\_x, n\_y) = (n\_1, n\_2).}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{phaseFromN}\NormalTok{(n}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{readonly}\NormalTok{ [}\DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  return }\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{atan2}\NormalTok{(n[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ n[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Update the unwrapped phase by adding the minimal{-}magnitude jump.}
\CommentTok{ * Inputs:}
\CommentTok{ *   prevTheta   — last raw atan2 in ({-}π, π]}
\CommentTok{ *   curTheta    — new raw atan2 in ({-}π, π]}
\CommentTok{ *   thetaTilde  — running unwrapped phase}
\CommentTok{ * Returns the new thetaTilde.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{unwrapPhase}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{  prevTheta}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ curTheta}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ thetaTilde}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,}

\NormalTok{    acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{arcLengthN} \OperatorTok{+=} \FunctionTok{geodesic}\NormalTok{(acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevN}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ n)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \}}

  \CommentTok{// Phase unwrap.}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevTheta} \OperatorTok{!==}\NormalTok{ null) \{}
\NormalTok{    acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thetaTilde} \OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{unwrapPhase}\NormalTok{(acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevTheta}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ theta}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thetaTilde}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \}}
\NormalTok{  acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{netWindingThetaTilde} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{thetaTilde}\OperatorTok{;}

  \CommentTok{// Free{-}group word (only if we have a prev to compare to).}
  \FunctionTok{if}\NormalTok{ (acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevN}\NormalTok{) \{}
\NormalTok{    acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{word} \OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{freeGroupTick}\NormalTok{(}
\NormalTok{      acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{word}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevN}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ n}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{      branchCuts}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{b1} \ImportTok{as} \DataTypeTok{any}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ branchCuts}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{b2} \ImportTok{as} \DataTypeTok{any}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{    )}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \}}

\NormalTok{  \}}

\NormalTok{  acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevN} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ n}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  acc}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{prevTheta} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ theta}\OperatorTok{;}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersmetrics.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/metrics.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/metrics.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersmetrics.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
// Shape-sphere coordinate, phase unwrap, and free-group bookkeeping in
// the GPU integrator. Compose with simulate.wgsl from M3.

fn shape_sphere(rho_t: vec2<f32>, lambda_t: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let rho_sq    = dot(rho_t,    rho_t);
  let lambda_sq = dot(lambda_t, lambda_t);
  let I = rho_sq + lambda_sq;
  if (I == 0.0) { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
  return vec3<f32>(
    (lambda_sq - rho_sq) / I,
    -2.0 * dot(rho_t, lambda_t) / I,
     2.0 * (rho_t.x * lambda_t.y - rho_t.y * lambda_t.x) / I,
  );
}

fn phase_from_n(n: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
  return atan2(n.y, n.x);
}

fn unwrap_phase(prev: f32, cur: f32, theta_tilde: f32) -> f32 {
  var d = cur - prev;
  if (d >  PI) { d = d - 2.0*PI; }
  if (d < -PI) { d = d + 2.0*PI; }
  return theta_tilde + d;
}

// Free-group word append with on-the-fly cancellation.
struct FreeWord {
  bits:   vec4<u32>,
  length: u32,
  truncated: u32,
};

fn append_symbol(word: FreeWord, sym: u32) -> FreeWord {
  var w = word;
  if (w.length >= 58u) { w.truncated = 1u; return w; }
  // Free reduction: aA, Aa, bB, Bb cancel.
  if (w.length > 0u) {
    let prev_slot = w.length - 1u;
    let lane = prev_slot >> 4u;
    let off  = (prev_slot & 0xfu) * 2u;
    var prev_bits: u32;
    switch (lane) {
      case 0u: { prev_bits = (w.bits.x >> off) & 0x3u; }
      case 1u: { prev_bits = (w.bits.y >> off) & 0x3u; }
      case 2u: { prev_bits = (w.bits.z >> off) & 0x3u; }
      default: { prev_bits = (w.bits.w >> off) & 0x3u; }
    }
    let cancels =
      (prev_bits == 0u && sym == 1u) ||
      (prev_bits == 1u && sym == 0u) ||
      (prev_bits == 2u && sym == 3u) ||
      (prev_bits == 3u && sym == 2u);
    if (cancels) {
      let mask = ~(0x3u << off);
      switch (lane) {
        case 0u: { w.bits.x = w.bits.x & mask; }
        case 1u: { w.bits.y = w.bits.y & mask; }
        case 2u: { w.bits.z = w.bits.z & mask; }
        default: { w.bits.w = w.bits.w & mask; }
      }
      w.length = w.length - 1u;
      return w;
    }
  }
  let lane = w.length >> 4u;
  let off  = (w.length & 0xfu) * 2u;
  switch (lane) {
    case 0u: { w.bits.x = w.bits.x | ((sym & 0x3u) << off); }
    case 1u: { w.bits.y = w.bits.y | ((sym & 0x3u) << off); }
    case 2u: { w.bits.z = w.bits.z | ((sym & 0x3u) << off); }
    default: { w.bits.w = w.bits.w | ((sym & 0x3u) << off); }
  }
  w.length = w.length + 1u;
  return w;
}

fn signed_plane(n: vec3<f32>, b: vec3<f32>, e: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
  let cr = vec3<f32>(b.y*e.z - b.z*e.y, b.z*e.x - b.x*e.z, b.x*e.y - b.y*e.x);
  return dot(n, cr);
}

fn pick_endpoint(b: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let north = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  let south = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
  let cr = cross(b, north);
  let sin_v = length(cr);
  if (sin_v < 0.1) { return south; }
  return north;
}

fn free_group_tick(
  w: FreeWord, prev_n: vec3<f32>, cur_n: vec3<f32>,
  b1: vec3<f32>, b2: vec3<f32>,
) -> FreeWord {
  var word = w;

  let e1 = pick_endpoint(b1);
  let dp1 = signed_plane(prev_n, b1, e1);
  let dc1 = signed_plane(cur_n,  b1, e1);
  if (dp1 != 0.0 && dc1 != 0.0 && sign(dp1) != sign(dc1)) {
    let sym1 = select(1u, 0u, dp1 > 0.0);
    word = append_symbol(word, sym1);
  }

  let e2 = pick_endpoint(b2);
  let dp2 = signed_plane(prev_n, b2, e2);
  let dc2 = signed_plane(cur_n,  b2, e2);
  if (dp2 != 0.0 && dc2 != 0.0 && sign(dp2) != sign(dc2)) {
    let sym2 = select(3u, 2u, dp2 > 0.0);
    word = append_symbol(word, sym2);
  }
  return word;
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{testgoldenfigure8_word.test.ts}{%
\subsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{test/golden/figure8\_word.test.ts}}{test/golden/figure8\_word.test.ts}}\label{testgoldenfigure8_word.test.ts}}

The figure-8 orbit (Chenciner--Montgomery) is a periodic equal-mass
three-body solution. Its homotopy class on the punctured shape sphere is
the commutator \texttt{{[}a,\ b{]}\ =\ a\ b\ a\^{}\{-1\}\ b\^{}\{-1\}},
written here as \texttt{abAB}. After multiple periods, the recorded word
should be a power of that base.

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ describe}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ it}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ expect \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}vitest\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ run \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/integrate/run.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ metricsTick}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ makeMetrics}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ DEFAULT\_BRANCH\_CUTS \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/metrics/observe\_extended.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ wordToString \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/metrics/free\_group.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ TrajState \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{// Chenciner–Montgomery initial conditions in the standard normalisation.}
\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{figure8IC}\NormalTok{()}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ TrajState \{}
  \CommentTok{// Velocity components (Chenciner–Montgomery 2000):}
  \CommentTok{//   r\_0 = {-}r\_2 = (0.97000436, {-}0.24308753)}
  \CommentTok{//   r\_1 = (0, 0)}
  \CommentTok{//   v\_0 = v\_2 = ({-}0.4662036850, {-}0.4323657300)/ 2}

\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\hypertarget{acceptance-check-6}{%
\section{Acceptance check}\label{acceptance-check-6}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/golden/metrics}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

All three goldens pass: - BC₁ at \texttt{(1,0,0)}, BC₃ at
\texttt{(-1/2,\ ±√3/2,\ 0)}, Lagrange at the poles. - Figure-8
free-group word reduces to a power of \texttt{abAB}. - Burrau FTLE is at
least 10× the regular orbit's.

\hypertarget{notes-for-the-implementer-4}{%
\section{Notes for the implementer}\label{notes-for-the-implementer-4}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Order of integration into M5.} The metrics fields populated by
  this milestone (\texttt{spread\_n}, \texttt{spread\_diffusion},
  \texttt{mean\_word\_length}, etc.) feed the coherence score from M5.
  Wire the second-pass spread computation into \texttt{reduce.wgsl} once
  \texttt{mean\_n\_checkpoints} is available from the first pass ---
  that's a 64-lane mean-then-spread pattern, identical to the one
  already there for \texttt{arc\_length\_n}.
\item
  \textbf{Branch-cut basepoints depend on masses.} The defaults
  \texttt{(1,\ 0,\ 0)} and \texttt{(-1/2,\ √3/2,\ 0)} are the equal-mass
  collision points in the corrected shape-sphere coordinate. For unequal
  masses, pass the mass-dependent \texttt{b̂\_i} from the chart; M11
  (Burrau) supplies them.
\item
  \textbf{FTLE on the GPU.} The Research-tier FTLE shader is
  structurally identical to the integrator with two trajectory states in
  registers. Each macro step kicks/drifts/kicks both, and the
  renormalisation cadence (\texttt{M\_renorm\ =\ 50} by default) is a
  thread-local counter. There is no inter-thread coordination, so the
  cost is just 2× registers and \textasciitilde2× ALU.
\item
  \textbf{The free-group encoding deliberately leaves \texttt{prev\_n}
  for the caller} to manage. In the GPU integrator, \texttt{prev\_n}
  lives next to the current state in workgroup-local registers; on the
  CPU the \texttt{MetricsAccumulator} carries it.
\end{itemize}

\newpage

\hypertarget{m7-render-graph-colour-brightness-combiner-post}{%
\chapter{M7 --- Render graph: colour, brightness, combiner,
post}\label{m7-render-graph-colour-brightness-combiner-post}}

\hypertarget{goal-7}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-7}}

A clean four-stage render pipeline so palette swaps don't trigger
recompute, and so adding a new visualisation mode is a leaf change.

\begin{verbatim}
SimResult ─[colour node]─► vec3 RGB ─┐
                                     ├─[combiner]─► RGB ─[post]─► canvas
SimResult ─[brightness node]─► f32 ──┘
\end{verbatim}

After M7, the GPU has 12 colour modes, 4 brightness modes, three
combiner modes, and CVD simulation in postprocess. Group 3
(\texttt{RenderParams}) is the only bind group rebinding that happens
when palette / overlay / CVD changes; groups 0/1/2 stay constant.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/render\_graph}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

A palette swap rebinds only group 3 --- it does not change any byte of
the \texttt{SimResult} storage buffer. The OKLAB round-trip holds to
1e-6 ΔE. The stability×hue mode reproduces the published reference frame
to within 2 ΔE per pixel.

\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ Vec3 \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/* ============================================================}
\CommentTok{ * sRGB ↔ linear sRGB (γ ≈ 2.2 piecewise transfer).}
\CommentTok{ * The render graph operates in linear sRGB throughout; the canvas}
\CommentTok{ * write applies the sRGB transfer function (or relies on the canvas}
\CommentTok{ * colour{-}space configuration to do it).}
\CommentTok{ * ============================================================ */}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{srgbToLinear}\NormalTok{(c}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  return c }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \FloatTok{0.04045} \OperatorTok{?}\NormalTok{ c }\OperatorTok{/} \FloatTok{12.92} \OperatorTok{:} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{pow}\NormalTok{((c }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.055}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{/} \FloatTok{1.055}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{2.4}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{linearToSrgb}\NormalTok{(c}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{:} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  return c }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \FloatTok{0.0031308}
    \OperatorTok{?} \FloatTok{12.92} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ c}
    \OperatorTok{:} \FloatTok{1.055} \OperatorTok{*} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{pow}\NormalTok{(c}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{/}\FloatTok{2.4}\NormalTok{) }\OperatorTok{{-}} \FloatTok{0.055}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/* ============================================================}
\CommentTok{ * Linear sRGB ↔ OKLAB (Björn Ottosson 2020).}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ *   M1 maps linear sRGB → LMS (cone fundamentals)}
\CommentTok{ *   apply cube root non{-}linearity}
\CommentTok{ *   M2 maps LMS\textquotesingle{} → OKLAB}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Inverses use the inverse matrices and a cube.}
\CommentTok{ * ============================================================ */}

\NormalTok{const M1 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
  \FloatTok{0.41222147079999996}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.5363325363}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.05144599826}\OperatorTok{,}
  \FloatTok{0.21190349577999998}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.6806995450}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.10739595388}\OperatorTok{,}
  \FloatTok{0.08830246189999998}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.2817188376}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.6299787005}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{const M2 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
   \FloatTok{0.21045426824999999}\OperatorTok{,}  \FloatTok{0.7936177850}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.0040720468}\OperatorTok{,}
   \FloatTok{1.97799849510000000}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{2.4285922050}\OperatorTok{,}  \FloatTok{0.4505937099}\OperatorTok{,}
   \FloatTok{0.02590404246000000}\OperatorTok{,}  \FloatTok{0.7827717662}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.8086757660}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}

\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{applyMat3}\NormalTok{(M}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{readonly} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{[]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ v}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \{}
\NormalTok{  return [}
\NormalTok{    M[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ M[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ M[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{    M[}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ M[}\DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ M[}\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{    M[}\DecValTok{6}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ M[}\DecValTok{7}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ M[}\DecValTok{8}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  ]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{linearRgbToOklab}\NormalTok{(c}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \{}
\NormalTok{  const lms }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{applyMat3}\NormalTok{(M1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ c)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const cb}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{cbrt}\NormalTok{(lms[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{,} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{cbrt}\NormalTok{(lms[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{,} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{cbrt}\NormalTok{(lms[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{])]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return }\FunctionTok{applyMat3}\NormalTok{(M2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cb)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\NormalTok{const M1inv }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
   \FloatTok{4.07674166134799}\OperatorTok{,}    \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{3.30771159040597}\OperatorTok{,}    \FloatTok{0.230969928729428}\OperatorTok{,}
  \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{1.26843799600028}\OperatorTok{,}     \FloatTok{2.60975740020587}\OperatorTok{,}   \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.341131342239416}\OperatorTok{,}
  \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.00419608654558288}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.703418816967143}\OperatorTok{,}   \FloatTok{1.70761470242744}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{const M2inv }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
   \FloatTok{0.999999999999999}\OperatorTok{,} \FloatTok{0.396337777878555}\OperatorTok{,}  \FloatTok{0.215803757065654}\OperatorTok{,}
   \FloatTok{1.000000000000000}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.105561345815734}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.063854174771706}\OperatorTok{,}
   \FloatTok{1.000000000000000}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.0894841779880559}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{1.291485537864750}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{oklabToLinearRgb}\NormalTok{(lab}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \{}
\NormalTok{  const cb }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{applyMat3}\NormalTok{(M2inv}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lab)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const lms}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [cb[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cb[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cb[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cb[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cb[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cb[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cb[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cb[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cb[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return }\FunctionTok{applyMat3}\NormalTok{(M1inv}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lms)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\CommentTok{/* ============================================================}
\CommentTok{ * OKLAB ↔ OKLCH (polar form for hue/chroma).}
\CommentTok{ * ============================================================ */}

\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{oklabToOklch}\NormalTok{(lab}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \{}
\NormalTok{  return [lab[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{hypot}\NormalTok{(lab[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lab[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{,} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{atan2}\NormalTok{(lab[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lab[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{oklchToOklab}\NormalTok{(lch}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3 \{}
\NormalTok{  return [lch[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lch[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{cos}\NormalTok{(lch[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lch[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{*} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sin}\NormalTok{(lch[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{])]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ Vec3 \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ oklabToLinearRgb}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ oklchToOklab \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}./oklab.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Six poles at the axis directions ±x̂, ±ŷ, ±ẑ. Hue assignments depend}
\CommentTok{ * on the scheme (full OKLAB vs Okabe–Ito CB{-}safe). All angles in degrees,}

\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export const POLE\_DIRECTIONS}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ Vec3[] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}
\NormalTok{  [ }\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ [}\OperatorTok{{-}}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  [ }\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ [ }\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  [ }\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ [ }\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}  \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{  close\_encounters}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ min\_approach}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ energy\_drift\_abs}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{17}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  energy\_drift\_rel}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{18}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lz\_drift\_abs}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{19}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lz\_drift\_rel}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{20}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  shape\_sphere\_vmf}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{21}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ shape\_sphere\_okabe\_ito}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{22}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ stability\_x\_hue}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{23}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{const BRIGHT\_MODE\_INDEX}\OperatorTok{:} \BuiltInTok{Record}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{RenderParams[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}brightnessMode\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  flat}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ time\_to\_event}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ diffusion}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  bc\_proximity}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ energy\_drift}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{const COMBINER\_INDEX}\OperatorTok{:} \BuiltInTok{Record}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{RenderParams[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}combinerMode\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  replace\_lightness}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ modulate\_lightness}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ multiply\_rgb}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{const CVD\_INDEX}\OperatorTok{:} \BuiltInTok{Record}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{RenderParams[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}cvdMode\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  none}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ protan}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ deutan}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ tritan}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ achrom}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{const PALETTE\_INDEX}\OperatorTok{:} \BuiltInTok{Record}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\NormalTok{RenderParams[}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}palette\textquotesingle{}}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{  viridis}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cividis}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ plasma}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ magma}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ inferno}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{  twilight}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{5}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cool\_warm}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{6}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ principia}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cubehelix}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{\}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * Pack RenderParams into a 64{-}byte uniform buffer for group(3) binding(0).}
\CommentTok{ *}
\CommentTok{ * Layout:}
\CommentTok{ *   [0..3]    colour\_mode\_id (u32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [4..7]    brightness\_mode\_id (u32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [8..11]   combiner\_id (u32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [12..15]  cvd\_id (u32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [16..19]  palette\_id (u32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [20..23]  physics\_overlay (u32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [24..27]  overlay\_strength (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [28..31]  vmf\_kappa (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [32..35]  vmf\_chroma (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [36..39]  vmf\_lightness (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [40..43]  palette\_range\_min (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [44..47]  palette\_range\_max (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [48..51]  playback\_tau (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [52..55]  wall\_clock (f32)}
\CommentTok{ *   [56..63]  reserved}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export }\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{packRenderParams}\NormalTok{(p}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ RenderParams)}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ ArrayBuffer \{}
\NormalTok{  const buf }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{ArrayBuffer}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{64}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const f32 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{Float32Array}\NormalTok{(buf)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const u32 }\OperatorTok{=} \KeywordTok{new} \FunctionTok{Uint32Array}\NormalTok{(buf)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  u32[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ COLOUR\_MODE\_INDEX[p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{colourMode}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  u32[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ BRIGHT\_MODE\_INDEX[p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{brightnessMode}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  u32[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ COMBINER\_INDEX[p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{combinerMode}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  u32[}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ CVD\_INDEX[p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{cvdMode}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  u32[}\DecValTok{4}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ PALETTE\_INDEX[p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{palette}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  u32[}\DecValTok{5}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{physicsOverlay} \OperatorTok{?} \DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{6}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{overlayStrength}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{7}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{vmfKappa}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{8}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{vmfChroma}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{9}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{vmfLightness}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{10}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{paletteRange}\NormalTok{[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{11}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{paletteRange}\NormalTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{12}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{playbackTau}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  f32[}\DecValTok{13}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ p}\OperatorTok{.}\AttributeTok{wallClockTime}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return buf}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}
\end{Highlighting}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersrender_helpers.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/render\_helpers.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/render\_helpers.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersrender_helpers.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
// Shared helpers used by colour, brightness, combiner, and CVD stages.
const PI: f32 = 3.141592653589793;

fn srgb_to_linear(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let lo = c / 12.92;
  let hi = pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, vec3<f32>(2.4));
  return select(hi, lo, c <= vec3<f32>(0.04045));
}

fn linear_to_srgb(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let lo = 12.92 * c;
  let hi = 1.055 * pow(c, vec3<f32>(1.0/2.4)) - 0.055;
  return select(hi, lo, c <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));
}

const M1_TO_LMS = mat3x3<f32>(
   0.4122214708,  0.5363325363,  0.0514459826,
   0.2119034958,  0.6806995450,  0.1073959539,
   0.0883024619,  0.2817188376,  0.6299787005,
);
const M2_TO_LAB = mat3x3<f32>(
   0.2104542553,  0.7936177850, -0.0040720468,
   1.9779984951, -2.4285922050,  0.4505937099,
   0.0259040247,  0.7827717662, -0.8086757660,
);
const M2_INV = mat3x3<f32>(
   1.0,  0.3963377774,  0.2158037573,
   1.0, -0.1055613458, -0.0638541728,
   1.0, -0.0894841775, -1.2914855480,
);
const M1_INV = mat3x3<f32>(
   4.0767416613, -3.3077115904,  0.2309699287,
  -1.2684379960,  2.6097574002, -0.3413113422,
  -0.0041960865, -0.7034188370,  1.7076147024,
);

fn linear_rgb_to_oklab(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let lms = M1_TO_LMS * c;
  let cb  = vec3<f32>(pow(lms.x, 1.0/3.0),
                      pow(lms.y, 1.0/3.0),
                      pow(lms.z, 1.0/3.0));
  return M2_TO_LAB * cb;
}

fn oklab_to_linear_rgb(lab: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
  let cb = M2_INV * lab;
  let lms = vec3<f32>(cb.x*cb.x*cb.x, cb.y*cb.y*cb.y, cb.z*cb.z*cb.z);
  return M1_INV * lms;
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushaderscolour_modes.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/colour\_modes.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/colour\_modes.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushaderscolour_modes.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
// One function per colour mode. Returns linear sRGB.

fn colour_event_class(class_: u32, detail: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
  switch (class_) {
    case 0u: { return vec3<f32>(0.7, 0.7, 0.2); }    // bounded
    case 1u: { return vec3<f32>(0.9, 0.1, 0.1); }    // collision
    case 2u: {
      // Different escape body → different hue.
      switch (detail) {
        case 0u: { return vec3<f32>(0.10, 0.40, 0.90); }    // blue
        case 1u: { return vec3<f32>(0.10, 0.80, 0.20); }    // green
        default: { return vec3<f32>(0.90, 0.55, 0.10); }    // amber
      }
    }
    case 3u: { return vec3<f32>(0.5, 0.5, 0.5); }    // degenerate
    default: { return vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.9, 0.0); }    // timeout / max-substeps
  }
}

fn palette_seq(t: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  // Inline 5-stop viridis sample. Production reads from a 1D texture.
  let stops = array<vec3<f32>, 5>(
    vec3<f32>(0.267, 0.005, 0.329),
    vec3<f32>(0.282, 0.140, 0.458),
    vec3<f32>(0.221, 0.402, 0.561),
    vec3<f32>(0.221, 0.700, 0.408),
    vec3<f32>(0.991, 0.906, 0.144),
  );
  let u = clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
  let f = u * 4.0;
  let i = u32(floor(f));
  let j = min(4u, i + 1u);
  let w = f - f32(i);
  return mix(stops[i], stops[j], w);
}

fn palette_div_symlog(x: f32, eps: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  let absx = abs(x);
  let signed = sign(x) *
               select(1.0 + log(absx / eps), absx / eps, absx > eps);
  let t = clamp(0.5 + 0.5 * signed / 8.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  return palette_seq(t);
}

// VMF blend (6-pole), Okabe–Ito hues (CB-safe).
fn vmf_okabe_ito(n: vec3<f32>, kappa: f32, chroma: f32, L: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  let pole = array<vec3<f32>, 6>(
    vec3<f32>( 1.0, 0.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    vec3<f32>( 0.0, 1.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>( 0.0,-1.0, 0.0),
    vec3<f32>( 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), vec3<f32>( 0.0, 0.0,-1.0),
  );
  let hue = array<f32, 6>(
    250.0 * PI/180.0,  70.0 * PI/180.0,
     30.0 * PI/180.0, 210.0 * PI/180.0,
    170.0 * PI/180.0, 350.0 * PI/180.0,
  );
  var maxv: f32 = -1e30;
  for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i = i + 1u) {
    let kd = kappa * dot(n, pole[i]);
    if (kd > maxv) { maxv = kd; }
  }
  var aSum: f32 = 0.0; var bSum: f32 = 0.0; var Z: f32 = 0.0;
  for (var i = 0u; i < 6u; i = i + 1u) {
    let kd = kappa * dot(n, pole[i]);
    let w  = exp(kd - maxv);
    Z = Z + w;
    aSum = aSum + w * cos(hue[i]);
    bSum = bSum + w * sin(hue[i]);
  }
  let a = chroma * aSum / Z;
  let b = chroma * bSum / Z;
  return oklab_to_linear_rgb(vec3<f32>(L, a, b));
}

// Stability × hue (the principal Principia mode).
fn stability_x_hue(
  n: vec3<f32>, diffusion: f32, kappa: f32, chroma: f32,
) -> vec3<f32> {
  // Hue from n.
  let base = vmf_okabe_ito(n, kappa, chroma, 0.7);
  // Modulate L by proximity to binary collisions.
  let b1 = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  let b2 = vec3<f32>(-0.5,  0.866025, 0.0);
  let b3 = vec3<f32>(-0.5, -0.866025, 0.0);
  let prox = max(max(dot(n, b1), dot(n, b2)), dot(n, b3));
  let L = 0.25 + 0.55 * 0.5 * (1.0 - prox);
  // Replace L in OKLAB.
  let lab = linear_rgb_to_oklab(base);
  return oklab_to_linear_rgb(vec3<f32>(L, lab.y, lab.z));
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersbrightness_modes.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/brightness\_modes.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/brightness\_modes.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersbrightness_modes.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
fn brightness_time_to_event(t_end: f32, T_horizon: f32) -> f32 {
  return clamp(1.0 - t_end / T_horizon, 0.0, 1.0);
}

fn brightness_diffusion(diffusion: f32) -> f32 {
  if (diffusion < 0.0) { return 0.5; }              // sentinel
  let D0 = 0.05;     let Dmax = 1.0;
  return clamp(log(1.0 + diffusion / D0) / log(1.0 + Dmax / D0), 0.0, 1.0);
}

fn brightness_bc_proximity(n: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
  let b1 = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  let b2 = vec3<f32>(-0.5,  0.866025, 0.0);
  let b3 = vec3<f32>(-0.5, -0.866025, 0.0);
  let prox = max(max(dot(n, b1), dot(n, b2)), dot(n, b3));
  return clamp(0.5 * (1.0 - prox), 0.0, 1.0);
}

fn brightness_energy_drift(drift: f32) -> f32 {
  // Map [1e-7, 1e-2] log → [1, 0]: low drift = bright, high = dark.
  let lo = log(1e-7); let hi = log(1e-2);
  let t = (log(max(drift, 1e-30)) - lo) / (hi - lo);
  return 1.0 - clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushaderscombiner.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/combiner.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/combiner.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushaderscombiner.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
fn combine_replace_lightness(rgb: vec3<f32>, L: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  let lab = linear_rgb_to_oklab(rgb);
  return oklab_to_linear_rgb(vec3<f32>(clamp(L, 0.0, 1.0), lab.y, lab.z));
}

fn combine_modulate_lightness(rgb: vec3<f32>, L: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  let lab = linear_rgb_to_oklab(rgb);
  return oklab_to_linear_rgb(vec3<f32>(lab.x * clamp(L, 0.0, 1.0),
                                       lab.y, lab.z));
}

fn combine_multiply_rgb(rgb: vec3<f32>, L: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
  return rgb * clamp(L, 0.0, 1.0);
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushaderscvd.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/cvd.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/cvd.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushaderscvd.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
fn apply_cvd(rgb: vec3<f32>, mode: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
  switch (mode) {
    case 1u: {       // protan
      return mat3x3<f32>(
        0.567, 0.433, 0.0,
        0.558, 0.442, 0.0,
        0.0,   0.242, 0.758,
      ) * rgb;
    }
    case 2u: {       // deutan
      return mat3x3<f32>(
        0.625, 0.375, 0.0,
        0.700, 0.300, 0.0,
        0.0,   0.300, 0.700,
      ) * rgb;
    }
    case 3u: {       // tritan
      return mat3x3<f32>(
        0.950, 0.050, 0.0,
        0.0,   0.433, 0.567,
        0.0,   0.475, 0.525,
      ) * rgb;
    }
    case 4u: {       // achrom
      let g = dot(rgb, vec3<f32>(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
      return vec3<f32>(g, g, g);
    }
    default: { return rgb; }
  }
}
\end{verbatim}

\hypertarget{srcgpushadersrender_graph.wgsl}{%
\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/gpu/shaders/render\_graph.wgsl}}{src/gpu/shaders/render\_graph.wgsl}}\label{srcgpushadersrender_graph.wgsl}}

\begin{verbatim}
struct RenderParams {
  colour_mode_id:    u32,
  brightness_mode_id:u32,
  combiner_id:       u32,
  cvd_id:            u32,
  palette_id:        u32,
  physics_overlay:   u32,
  overlay_strength:  f32,
  vmf_kappa:         f32,
  vmf_chroma:        f32,
  vmf_lightness:     f32,
  palette_range_min: f32,
  palette_range_max: f32,
  playback_tau:      f32,
  wall_clock:        f32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> uniforms : SimUniforms;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> tile_req : TileRequest;
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> results : array<SimResult>;
@group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read> ics     : array<ICDescriptor>;
@group(3) @binding(0) var<uniform>      rparams : RenderParams;

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vid: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4<f32> {
  let pos = array<vec2<f32>, 3>(
    vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(3.0, -1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0, 3.0));
  return vec4<f32>(pos[vid], 0.0, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(@builtin(position) frag: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
  let N = uniforms.samples_per_axis;
  let tile_pix = 32.0;          // see M3 note; promoted to a uniform in M5+
  let sx = u32(floor(frag.x / tile_pix));
  let sy = u32(floor(frag.y / tile_pix));
  let idx = clamp(sy * N + sx, 0u, N*N - 1u);

  let r  = results[idx];
  let ic = ics[idx];
  let cls    = r.sample_descriptor & 0x7u;
  let detail = (r.sample_descriptor >> 3u) & 0x3u;

  // 1. Colour node.
  var rgb: vec3<f32>;
  let n_last = r.n_checkpoints[7].xyz;     // M=8

  switch (rparams.colour_mode_id) {
    case 0u:  { rgb = colour_event_class(cls, detail); }
    case 1u:  { rgb = palette_div_symlog(ic.K_0 + ic.V_0, 1e-3); }
    case 2u:  { rgb = palette_div_symlog(r.Lz_0,           1e-3); }
    case 3u:  { rgb = palette_seq(ic.K_0 / 4.0); }
    case 4u:  { rgb = palette_seq(-ic.V_0 / 4.0); }
    case 5u:  { rgb = palette_div_symlog(ic.virial_ratio - 1.0, 0.1); }
    case 6u:  { rgb = palette_div_symlog(log(ic.m1 / ic.m2), 0.5); }
    case 7u:  { rgb = palette_div_symlog(log(ic.m1 / ic.m3), 0.5); }
    case 8u:  { rgb = palette_seq(ic.q_mass * 3.0); }
    case 9u:  { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(ic.rho1_mag, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 10u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(ic.rho2_mag, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 11u: { rgb = palette_div_symlog(log(ic.rho_ratio), 1.0); }
    case 12u: { rgb = palette_seq((ic.rho_angle + PI) / (2.0 * PI)); }
    case 13u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(ic.r_min_pair_0 * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 14u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(r.t_end / uniforms.T_horizon, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 15u: { rgb = palette_seq(f32((r.sample_descriptor >> 9u) & 0x7fu) / 64.0); }
    case 16u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(r.d_min, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 17u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(log(r.delta_E_max_abs + 1e-10) / log(1e-2) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 18u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(log(r.energy_drift + 1e-10) / log(1e-2) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 19u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(log(r.delta_Lz_max_abs + 1e-10) / log(1e-2) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 20u: { rgb = palette_seq(clamp(log(r.Lz_drift + 1e-10) / log(1e-2) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)); }
    case 21u: { rgb = vmf_okabe_ito(n_last, rparams.vmf_kappa, rparams.vmf_chroma, rparams.vmf_lightness); }
    case 22u: { rgb = vmf_okabe_ito(n_last, rparams.vmf_kappa, rparams.vmf_chroma, rparams.vmf_lightness); }
    default:  { rgb = stability_x_hue(n_last, r.diffusion, rparams.vmf_kappa, rparams.vmf_chroma); }
  }

  // 2. Brightness node.
  var L: f32 = 1.0;
  switch (rparams.brightness_mode_id) {
    case 0u: { L = 1.0; }
    case 1u: { L = brightness_time_to_event(r.t_end, uniforms.T_horizon); }
    case 2u: { L = brightness_diffusion(r.diffusion); }
    case 3u: { L = brightness_bc_proximity(n_last); }
    default: { L = brightness_energy_drift(r.energy_drift); }
  }

  // 3. Combiner.
  var combined: vec3<f32>;
  switch (rparams.combiner_id) {
    case 0u: { combined = combine_replace_lightness(rgb, L); }
    case 1u: { combined = combine_modulate_lightness(rgb, L); }
    default: { combined = combine_multiply_rgb(rgb, L); }
  }

  // 4. Postprocess: CVD then sRGB encode.
  let post = apply_cvd(combined, rparams.cvd_id);
  return vec4<f32>(linear_to_srgb(post), 1.0);
}
\end{verbatim}

    \FunctionTok{for}\NormalTok{ (let t }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ t }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ t }\OperatorTok{+=} \FloatTok{0.1}\NormalTok{) \{}

\ImportTok{import}\NormalTok{ \{ describe}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ it}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ expect \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}vitest\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * CPU{-}side reference for the stability×hue mode. Every pixel:}
\CommentTok{ *   1. shape{-}sphere n  →  vmf\_okabe\_ito → base RGB}
\CommentTok{ *   2. compute proximity{-}to{-}BC (max over 3 BC unit vectors)}
\CommentTok{ *   3. L = 0.25 + 0.55 * 0.5 * (1 {-} prox)}
\CommentTok{ *   4. replace L in OKLAB}

\CommentTok{ * landmark positions on the shape sphere.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\KeywordTok{function} \FunctionTok{cpuStabilityHue}\NormalTok{(n}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [}\DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ [}\DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{] \{}
\NormalTok{  const base }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{vmfBlend}\NormalTok{(n}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ HUE\_OKABE\_ITO}\OperatorTok{,}
\NormalTok{                        \{ kappa}\OperatorTok{:} \DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ chroma}\OperatorTok{:} \FloatTok{0.15}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lightness}\OperatorTok{:} \FloatTok{0.7}\NormalTok{ \})}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const b1 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [ }\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ const}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const b2 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.5}\OperatorTok{,}  \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ const}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const b3 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ [}\OperatorTok{{-}}\FloatTok{0.5}\OperatorTok{,} \OperatorTok{{-}}\BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{sqrt}\NormalTok{(}\DecValTok{3}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{/}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\ImportTok{as}\NormalTok{ const}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const dot }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ (u}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{readonly} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{[]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ v}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{readonly} \DataTypeTok{number}\NormalTok{[]) }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}
\NormalTok{    u[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ u[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ u[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{v[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const prox }\OperatorTok{=} \BuiltInTok{Math}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{max}\NormalTok{(}\FunctionTok{dot}\NormalTok{(n}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ b1)}\OperatorTok{,} \FunctionTok{dot}\NormalTok{(n}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ b2)}\OperatorTok{,} \FunctionTok{dot}\NormalTok{(n}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ b3))}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const L }\OperatorTok{=} \FloatTok{0.25} \OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.55} \OperatorTok{*} \FloatTok{0.5} \OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{ (}\DecValTok{1} \OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{ prox)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  const lab }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{linearRgbToOklab}\NormalTok{(base)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  return }\FunctionTok{oklabToLinearRgb}\NormalTok{([L}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lab[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ lab[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{\}}

\FunctionTok{describe}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}stability × hue reference values\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
  \FunctionTok{it}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}binary collisions are dark\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{    const c }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{cpuStabilityHue}\NormalTok{([}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const lum }\OperatorTok{=} \FloatTok{0.299}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{c[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.587}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{c[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.114}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{c[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{    const c }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{cpuStabilityHue}\NormalTok{([}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const lum }\OperatorTok{=} \FloatTok{0.299}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{c[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.587}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{c[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.114}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{c[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(lum)}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeGreaterThan}\NormalTok{(}\FloatTok{0.5}\NormalTok{)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \})}\OperatorTok{;}

  \FunctionTok{it}\NormalTok{(}\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}mid{-}equator is intermediate\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ () }\KeywordTok{=\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ \{}
\NormalTok{    const cMid }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{cpuStabilityHue}\NormalTok{([}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const lumMid }\OperatorTok{=} \FloatTok{0.299}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cMid[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.587}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cMid[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.114}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cMid[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const cBC  }\OperatorTok{=} \FunctionTok{cpuStabilityHue}\NormalTok{([}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{,} \DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{])}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    const lumBC  }\OperatorTok{=} \FloatTok{0.299}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cBC[}\DecValTok{0}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.587}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cBC[}\DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{] }\OperatorTok{+} \FloatTok{0.114}\OperatorTok{*}\NormalTok{cBC[}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{]}\OperatorTok{;}
    \FunctionTok{expect}\NormalTok{(lumMid)}\OperatorTok{.}\FunctionTok{toBeGreaterThan}\NormalTok{(lumBC)}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  \})}\OperatorTok{;}

\texttt{render\_graph\_palette\_swap} confirms only
\texttt{RenderParams} differs between two renders that differ only in
palette, and \texttt{render\_graph\_stability\_hue} verifies the
reference luminance ordering for the principal Principia colour mode.

\hypertarget{notes-for-the-implementer-5}{%
\section{Notes for the implementer}\label{notes-for-the-implementer-5}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Palette swap = group 3 rebind only.} The render pipeline keeps
  the same vertex / fragment modules for every mode; only
  \texttt{RenderParams} changes. The branchy \texttt{switch} on
  \texttt{colour\_mode\_id} lives in the same shader module --- not
  separate pipeline objects per mode --- because pipeline switching cost
  would dwarf the cost of one branch on a 32-byte uniform. M10 may
  revisit this if a particular mode's dead code becomes significant.
\item
  \textbf{Stages cleanly composable.} Adding mode 24 means: extending
  the \texttt{ColourMode} union, adding an entry to
  \texttt{COLOUR\_MODE\_INDEX} and \texttt{COLOUR\_SOURCES}, and a new
  \texttt{case} in the colour-mode shader. No changes to
  \texttt{params.ts}'s buffer layout, no changes to the M3/M5 sim or
  reduction shaders.
\item
  \textbf{Gamma handling.} Everything between the colour node and the
  CVD output runs in linear sRGB. The CVD matrices are linear-sRGB
  matrices (the canonical Brettel/Viénot/Mollon formulation). The final
  \texttt{linear\_to\_srgb} is the only gamma encode in the pipeline.
  Applying CVD in gamma-encoded space looks visibly wrong (colours too
  dark) --- this is the bug you'll see if you reorder the post stages.
\item
  \textbf{Physics overlay} is intentionally omitted from M7's WGSL ---
  the marker-glyph sprites for BC / Euler / Lagrange points belong to
  M10 alongside the chart-aware overlay registry. M7 just leaves the
  \texttt{physics\_overlay} flag in \texttt{RenderParams} so the
  contract is stable.
\end{itemize}

\newpage

\hypertarget{m8-interaction-microscope-lock-lookup-tilt}{%
\chapter{M8 --- Interaction: microscope, lock, lookup,
tilt}\label{m8-interaction-microscope-lock-lookup-tilt}}

\hypertarget{goal-8}{%
\section{Goal}\label{goal-8}}

Land the user-facing controls as a thin layer on top of
\texttt{ViewState}. Every gesture is a transform of the same canonical
state object; the cache key (M4) is derived from it; the GPU pipeline
never knows or cares which gesture produced its inputs.

After M8: per-dimension sliders, log-stepped zoom, two independent tilt
sliders with Gram--Schmidt re-orthonormalisation, the lock gesture for
both affine and nonlinear charts, lookup from mass tuples / Pythagorean
triples / raw \texttt{z} / physical IC, and the lock-preservation policy
for chart switches.

\textbf{Exit criterion.}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ExtensionTok{npm}\NormalTok{ test {-}{-} {-}{-}run test/integration/interact}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

A click on a pixel produces a \texttt{ViewState} whose \texttt{z0}
decodes back to the clicked physical IC to within 1e-9 (affine charts)
or 1e-6 (nonlinear charts). Locking, switching chart, and unlocking
preserves the physical IC across the round trip. A tilt sweep into a
hidden dimension produces a sequence of consistent slice cross-sections
(no normalisation jitter).

\section{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{src/interact/view\_state.ts}}{src/interact/view\_state.ts}}\label{srcinteractview_state.ts}}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ Vec2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ Vec8 \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/math/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{import} \ImportTok{type}\NormalTok{ \{ TileCacheKey \} from }\StringTok{\textquotesingle{}@/quadtree/types.js\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ IntegratorId }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}kdk\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}yoshida4\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}yoshida6\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}rk4\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}
\ImportTok{export type}\NormalTok{ QualityTier  }\OperatorTok{=} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}preview\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}balanced\textquotesingle{}} \OperatorTok{|} \StringTok{\textquotesingle{}research\textquotesingle{}}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{/**}
\CommentTok{ * The single source of truth for the renderer, scheduler, exporter, and}
\CommentTok{ * URL{-}sharing system. Everything else in M8+ either reads or writes}
\CommentTok{ * \textasciigrave{}ViewState\textasciigrave{}.}
\CommentTok{ */}
\NormalTok{export interface ViewState \{}
  \CommentTok{/** Active chart. M10 registers the concrete charts; M8 is chart{-}agnostic. */}
\NormalTok{  chartType}\OperatorTok{:}    \DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  chartParams}\OperatorTok{:}  \BuiltInTok{Record}\OperatorTok{\textless{}}\DataTypeTok{string}\OperatorTok{,} \DataTypeTok{unknown}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{};}

  \CommentTok{/** 8D centre of the current slice. */}
\NormalTok{  z0}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{           Vec8}\OperatorTok{;}

\CommentTok{   *  hAxis/vAxis are derived. For mixed{-}axis / invariant charts, hAxis}
\CommentTok{   *  and vAxis are authoritative; q1, q2 are derived from the chart}
\CommentTok{   *  factory and stored only for serialisation completeness. */}
\NormalTok{  hAxis}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  vAxis}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  q1}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{           Vec8}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  q2}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{           Vec8}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  mag}\OperatorTok{:}          \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}          \CommentTok{// half{-}width of the slice in latent space}

\NormalTok{  rotation}\OperatorTok{:}     \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{  tilt1}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}          \CommentTok{// [{-}π/2, +π/2]}
\NormalTok{  tilt2}\OperatorTok{:}        \DataTypeTok{number}\OperatorTok{;}
